autoStep(){if(!this.autoRun||this.winner)return;if(Date.now()-this.lastHuman<1700)return;let order=['launch','melee','guard','core'];let kind=order[(this.round+this.chain+(this.turn==='P1'?this.pActive:this.rActive))%order.length];let lh=this.lastHuman;this.record('▶ Auto Engine chooses '+kind+' in '+this.body.name+'.');this.fireAction(kind,true);this.lastHuman=lh;if(!this.winner&&this.energyVal<=2){this.endTurn(true);this.lastHuman=lh}},

shiftState(n){let delta=Math.max(1,Math.round(n*3));if(this.turn==='P1')this.stateMeter=Math.min(100,this.stateMeter+delta);else this.stateMeter=Math.max(0,this.stateMeter-delta);if(this.stateMeter>=70)this.pop(this.player.x,this.player.y-52,this.perk(),this.active().color);if(this.stateMeter<=30)this.pop(this.player.x,this.player.y-52,this.perk(),'#ff6d7a')},
swapNext(){this.markUser();if(this.energyVal<=0)return this.record('No energy.');if(this.turn==='P1')this.pActive=(this.pActive+1)%this.pCrew.length;else this.rActive=(this.rActive+1)%this.rCrew.length;this.energyVal--;this.chain+=this.traitBonus('swap')?2:1;this.pop(this.player.x,this.player.y-30,'SWAP',this.active().color);this.record('🔁 '+this.turn+' swapped entity → '+this.active().n+'.');this.renderCrew();this.autoSave('swap');this.update()},

step(){let p=this.player;p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(this.aimMode==='Card'){p.vx*=.94;p.vy*=.94}else{p.vx*=.982;p.vy*=.982}if(p.x<p.r||p.x>this.w-p.r){p.vx*=-.78;p.x=Math.max(p.r,Math.min(this.w-p.r,p.x));if(Math.abs(p.vx)>1){this.damageOpponent(.25);this.pop(p.x,p.y-20,'BOUNCE',this.active().color)}}if(p.y<p.r||p.y>this.h-p.r){p.vy*=-.78;p.y=Math.max(p.r,Math.min(this.h-p.r,p.y));if(Math.abs(p.vy)>1){this.damageOpponent(.25);this.pop(p.x,p.y-20,'BOUNCE',this.active().color)}}for(let h of this.hazards){if(Math.hypot(p.x-h.x,p.y-h.y)<p.r+h.r){p.vx*=h.type==='bounce'?-1.05:.82;p.vy*=h.type==='bounce'?-1.05:.82;this.pop(h.x,h.y-20,h.type.toUpperCase(),'#ffd37a')}}if(Math.hypot(p.x-this.coreObj.x,p.y-this.coreObj.y)<p.r+this.coreObj.r&&!this.winner){let dmg=.7+this.pressureBonus();this.damageOpponent(dmg);this.pop(this.coreObj.x,this.coreObj.y-45,'HIT -'+dmg.toFixed(1),'#ff6d7a');this.flash=8;p.vx*=-.84;p.vy*=-.84}if(this.meleePulse)this.meleePulse.life--;if(this.meleePulse&&this.meleePulse.life<=0)this.meleePulse=null;this.fx.forEach(f=>{f.y-=.35;f.life--});this.fx=this.fx.filter(f=>f.life>0);if(this.flash>0)this.flash--},

      gfChallenge.textContent=lvl.name;gfLevel.textContent=(this.run.levelIndex+1)+'/'+c.levels.length;gfObjective.textContent=lvl.objective+' · '+this.progressText();gfResource.textContent=this.resourceLabel();gfRewards.textContent='★'+this.save.stars+' · '+this.save.tokens+'T';
      const pct=g.type==='winBeforeRound'||g.type==='win'?(this.run.won?100:0):Math.min(100,(v/g.target)*100);gfObjectiveFill.style.width=pct+'%';
      powerBtn.classList.toggle('powerReady',this.powerReady());powerBtn.querySelector('b').textContent=this.powerReady()?'✦ POWER READY':'✦ POWER';
    },
    decideRival(){
      const r=GFN.config.rules,energy=GF.energyVal,health=GF.p2/Math.max(1,this.level().enemy),player=GF.p1/Math.max(1,this.level().core),options=[];
      if(energy>=r.guardCost&&health<.42)options.push(['guard',7]);
      if(energy>=r.coreCost&&GF.chain>=2)options.push(['core',8]);
      if(energy>=r.coreCost&&player<.3)options.push(['core',10]);
      if(energy>=r.meleeCost)options.push(['melee',GF.body.id==='burning'?8:5]);
      if(energy>=r.launchCost)options.push(['launch',6]);
      if(energy>=r.guardCost)options.push(['guard',GF.body.id==='humanimals'?6:2]);
      if(!options.length)return null;
      const total=options.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0);let roll=((GF.round*17+GF.chain*11+GF.rActive*7)%total);
      for(const [kind,w] of options){roll-=w;if(roll<0)return kind}return options[0][0];
    },
    rivalTurn(){

        const kind=this.decideRival();if(!kind){baseEndTurn(true);this.rivalBusy=false;return}
        GF.record('🤖 '+diff+' rival routes '+kind+'.');GF.fireAction(kind,true);n++;setTimeout(act,this.save.settings.reduceMotion?20:360)};
      act();
    },
    renderCampaign(){
      const c=this.campaign(),body=GF.body.id,current=this.save.level[body]||0,unlock=this.save.unlocked[body]||1;
      forgeBody.innerHTML=`<div class="forgeSection"><h3>${GFN.esc(c.title)}</h3><p>${GFN.esc(c.line)}</p>
      <div class="campaignSummary"><strong>${GFN.esc(c.levels[current].name)}</strong><br>${GFN.esc(c.levels[current].objective)}<div class="rewardRail"><span class="rewardChip">★ ${this.save.stars}</span><span class="rewardChip">${this.save.tokens} TOKENS</span><span class="rewardChip">${this.resourceLabel()}</span></div></div>
      <div class="campaignGrid">${c.levels.map((l,i)=>`<div class="levelCard ${i===current?'active':''} ${i>=unlock?'locked':''} ${this.save.completed[body+':'+i]?'complete':''}"><b>${i+1}. ${GFN.esc(l.name)}</b><span>${GFN.esc(l.objective)}</span><span>${GFN.esc(l.difficulty)} · Rival ${GFN.esc(l.ai)}</span><span>Reward: ${l.reward.stars}★ + ${l.reward.tokens} tokens</span><button data-level="${i}">${i>=unlock?'LOCKED':i===current?'RESTART':'PLAY LEVEL'}</button></div>`).join('')}</div>
      <h3>Campaign tuning</h3><div class="forgeGrid">${GFN.field('Objective target','_campaign.target','Current challenge target.')}${GFN.field('Reward stars','_campaign.stars','Completion stars.')}${GFN.field('Reward tokens','_campaign.tokens','Completion tokens.')}${GFN.field('Automatic rival','_campaign.autoRival','Rival acts after the player ends the turn.','checkbox')}${GFN.field('Haptics','_campaign.haptics','Device vibration where supported.','checkbox')}${GFN.field('High contrast','_campaign.highContrast','Accessibility contrast mode.','checkbox')}${GFN.field('Reduced motion','_campaign.reduceMotion','Minimise animation and delay.','checkbox')}</div>
      <div class="forgeActions"><button data-campaign-action="next">NEXT LEVEL</button><button data-campaign-action="reset">RESET THIS CAMPAIGN</button></div></div>`;

      const goal=c.levels[current].goal;
      const map={target:goal.target,stars:c.levels[current].reward.stars,tokens:c.levels[current].reward.tokens,autoRival:this.save.settings.autoRival,haptics:this.save.settings.haptics,highContrast:this.save.settings.highContrast,reduceMotion:this.save.settings.reduceMotion};
      forgeBody.querySelectorAll('[data-path^="_campaign."]').forEach(el=>{const key=el.dataset.path.split('.')[1];if(el.type==='checkbox')el.checked=!!map[key];else el.value=map[key];el.onchange=()=>{const v=el.type==='checkbox'?el.checked:Number(el.value);if(key==='target')goal.target=v;else if(key==='stars')c.levels[current].reward.stars=v;else if(key==='tokens')c.levels[current].reward.tokens=v;else this.save.settings[key]=v;this.applyAccess();this.persist();this.updateHUD();setTimeout(()=>this.renderCampaign(),0)}});
    }
  };
  window.GFPLAY=GFPLAY;GFPLAY.load();

  // Patch native Forge without replacing it.
  const baseRenderForge=GFN.renderForge.bind(GFN);
  GFN.renderForge=function(){if(this.tab==='campaign'){document.querySelectorAll('[data-forge-tab]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('activeBtn',b.dataset.forgeTab==='campaign'));forgeSub.textContent='Playable depth · CAMPAIGN';GFPLAY.renderCampaign();return}baseRenderForge()};
  campaignTab.onclick=()=>{GFN.tab='campaign';GFN.renderForge()};
  const baseCommand=GFN.command.bind(GFN);
  GFN.command=function(raw){const l=String(raw||'').toLowerCase(),m=l.match(/\d+/);
    if(/next level/.test(l))return GFPLAY.nextLevel();
    if(/start level/.test(l)&&m)return GFPLAY.chooseLevel(Math.max(0,Number(m[0])-1));
    if(/objective target/.test(l)&&m){GFPLAY.level().goal.target=Number(m[0]);GFPLAY.persist();GFPLAY.updateHUD();return GFN.applyLive('Objective target '+m[0])}
    if(/difficulty.*(standard|sharp|relentless)/.test(l)){GFPLAY.save.settings.difficulty=l.match(/standard|sharp|relentless/)[0].replace(/^./,x=>x.toUpperCase());GFPLAY.persist();return GFN.applyLive('Difficulty '+GFPLAY.save.settings.difficulty)}
    if(/body power|use power|trigger power/.test(l))return GFPLAY.power();
    return baseCommand(raw)};
  const baseProof=GFN.renderProof.bind(GFN);
  GFN.renderProof=function(){baseProof();const p=document.querySelector('#forgeBody .routeProof');if(p)p.textContent+=`\nCAMPAIGN: ${GFPLAY.campaign().title}\nLEVEL: ${GFPLAY.run.levelIndex+1} · ${GFPLAY.level().name}\nOBJECTIVE: ${GFPLAY.level().objective} · ${GFPLAY.progressText()}\nREWARDS: ${GFPLAY.save.stars} stars · ${GFPLAY.save.tokens} tokens\nPLAYWORTHY LAYER: native v3.16 alpha`;};

  // Patch live body lifecycle.
  const baseApplyBody=GF.applyBody.bind(GF);
  GF.applyBody=function(id,announce=true){baseApplyBody(id,announce);GFPLAY.resetRun(id)};
  const baseFireAction=GF.fireAction.bind(GF);
  GF.fireAction=function(kind,auto=false){const before={p1:this.p1,p2:this.p2,e:this.energyVal};const restore=GFPLAY.beforeAction(kind);baseFireAction(kind,auto);restore();GFPLAY.afterAction(kind,before);GFPLAY.updateHUD()};
  const baseSwap=GF.swapNext.bind(GF);
  GF.swapNext=function(){const before=this.pActive;baseSwap();if(this.turn==='P1'&&this.pActive!==before){GFPLAY.track('crew');if(this.body.id==='humanimals')GFPLAY.track('instinct',8)}};
  const baseDamage=GF.damageOpponent.bind(GF);
  GF.damageOpponent=function(n){baseDamage(n);GFPLAY.checkObjective()};
  const baseEndTurn=GF.endTurn.bind(GF);
  window.baseEndTurn=baseEndTurn;
  GF.endTurn=function(auto=false){const was=this.turn;baseEndTurn(auto);if(was==='P1'&&!this.winner&&GFPLAY.save.settings.autoRival&&!auto)setTimeout(()=>GFPLAY.rivalTurn(),GFPLAY.save.settings.reduceMotion?25:420)};
  GF.rivalAction=function(){GFPLAY.rivalTurn()};
  const baseCheckWin=GF.checkWin.bind(GF);
  GF.checkWin=function(){baseCheckWin();if(this.winner==='P1'){GFPLAY.track('win');GFPLAY.chord([260,390,520])}else if(this.winner==='P2'){GFPLAY.haptic([120,60,120])}};
  const baseStep=GF.step.bind(GF);
  GF.step=function(){baseStep();GFPLAY.updateParticles();
    if(this.body.id==='humanimals'&&this.turn==='P1'){
      const now=Date.now();
      for(const h of this.hazards.filter(x=>x.type==='spirit')){
        if(now-GFPLAY.run.lastSpiritAt>700&&Math.hypot(this.player.x-h.x,this.player.y-h.y)<this.player.r+h.r+4){
          GFPLAY.run.lastSpiritAt=now;GFPLAY.track('spirit');GFPLAY.track('instinct',12);this.pop(h.x,h.y-28,'SPIRIT +1','#9bea9f');h.x=180+Math.random()*540;h.y=120+Math.random()*320;GFPLAY.tone(520,.1,'sine');GFPLAY.haptic(35);
        }
      }
    }
    if(this.body.id==='burning'){
      for(const h of this.hazards){if(h.type==='heat'&&Math.hypot(this.player.x-h.x,this.player.y-h.y)<this.player.r+h.r+3){GFPLAY.track('heat',.08)}if(h.type==='boost'&&Math.hypot(this.player.x-h.x,this.player.y-h.y)<this.player.r+h.r+3){this.player.vx*=1.004;this.player.vy*=1.004}}
    }
  };
  const baseDraw=GF.draw.bind(GF);
  GF.draw=function(){baseDraw();GFPLAY.drawOverlay()};
  const baseUpdate=GF.update.bind(GF);
  GF.update=function(){baseUpdate();GFPLAY.updateHUD()};
  const baseSnap=GF.snapshot.bind(GF);
  GF.snapshot=function(reason='snapshot'){const s=baseSnap(reason);s.version='v3.16-alpha';s.playworthy={campaign:GFPLAY.campaign().title,level:GFPLAY.level().name,objective:GFPLAY.level().objective,run:GFPLAY.run,rewards:{stars:GFPLAY.save.stars,tokens:GFPLAY.save.tokens}};return s};

  // Direct contact for body power and campaign HUD.
  powerBtn.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(GFN.edit){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();GFN.tab='campaign';GFN.openForge('campaign')}},true);
  objective.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(GFN.edit){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();GFN.tab='campaign';GFN.openForge('campaign')}},true);

  GFPLAY.resetRun(GF.body.id);GF.applyBody(GF.body.id,false);GFPLAY.updateHUD();
  GF.record('🔥 GameForge v3.15 Playworthy campaign layer ready.');
})();
</script>


<script id="gameforge-1p-separation-v316">
(() => {

  };
  const GFUX={
    version:'3.16-alpha',matchStarted:false,firstMove:false,resultHandled:false,suppressPrepare:false,lastIntent:'Waiting for your turn',
    info(){return GAME_INFO[GF.body.id]||GAME_INFO.blank},
    prepare(reason='game selected'){

      this.lastIntent='Waiting for your turn';this.sync();
      GF.record('🎮 '+i.game+' ready · one player versus AI rival.');
    },
    start(restart=false){
      this.suppressPrepare=true;GF.applyBody(GF.body.id,false);this.suppressPrepare=false;

      playStartPanel.hidden=true;matchResultPanel.hidden=true;document.body.classList.remove('matchIdle','rivalTurn');
      this.showGuide('YOUR TURN','Touch '+GF.active('P1').n+', drag backwards, and release.');
      GF.say('ROOT: Game','ROUTE: One Player vs AI','NEXT: Aim and release');
      GF.record((restart?'↻ Restarted ':'▶ Started ')+this.info().game+' · you control P1.');
      GF.update();
    },
    showGuide(title,text,ms=0){turnGuideTitle.textContent=title;turnGuideText.textContent=text;turnGuide.hidden=false;if(ms)setTimeout(()=>{if(turnGuideText.textContent===text)turnGuide.hidden=true},ms)},

    onResult(){

      if(GFN.config.match.mode!=='Round Ladder'){GFN.progress.wins[GF.winner]=(GFN.progress.wins[GF.winner]||0)+1;GFN.updateProgress();GFN.saveConfig()}
      const you=GF.winner==='P1';matchResultTitle.textContent=you?'YOU WIN':'RIVAL WINS';
      matchResultReason.textContent=you?this.info().win+'.':'Your Core was broken. Restart or tune the challenge.';

      matchResultPanel.hidden=false;turnGuide.hidden=true;this.sync();
    },
    sync(){
      const i=this.info();contractGame.textContent=i.game;contractInput.textContent=i.input;contractPlay.textContent=i.play;contractWin.textContent=i.win;
      const p1=p1Label.textContent.replace(/^YOU · /,'').replace(/^PLAYER · /,'');const p2=p2Label.textContent.replace(/^RIVAL · /,'');
      p1Label.textContent='YOU · '+p1;p2Label.textContent='RIVAL · '+p2;
      const contractLabel=document.querySelector('#gfContract')?.previousElementSibling;if(contractLabel)contractLabel.textContent='SIDE CONTRACT';
      pressureLabel.textContent='MOMENTUM · '+GF.perk()+' · '+Math.round(GF.stateMeter)+'%';
      cEnd.querySelector('b').textContent='⏭ END TURN → RIVAL';
      if(!this.matchStarted&&!GF.winner){matchState.textContent='READY';turn.textContent='YOU';matchRouteState.textContent='READY · START 1P GAME';nextContactText.textContent='Start the match'}
      else if(GF.winner){matchRouteState.textContent='COMPLETE · '+(GF.winner==='P1'?'YOU WIN':'RIVAL WINS');nextContactText.textContent='Restart or continue'}
      else if(GF.turn==='P1'){turn.textContent='YOUR TURN';matchRouteState.textContent='LIVE · YOUR ACTION';nextContactText.textContent=this.firstMove?'Choose a loop or end turn':'Touch, drag backwards, release';this.lastIntent='Waiting for your turn';document.body.classList.remove('rivalTurn')}
      else{turn.textContent='RIVAL TURN';matchRouteState.textContent='LIVE · RIVAL RESPONSE';nextContactText.textContent='Watch the rival route';document.body.classList.add('rivalTurn')}
      rivalIntentText.textContent=this.lastIntent;
    },
    startDemo(){
      if(!this.matchStarted)this.start(false);GF.autoRun=true;GF.lastHuman=0;cAuto.classList.add('activeBtn');GF.record('🧪 AI Test started from Proof—not from the player deck.');
    },
    stopDemo(){GF.autoRun=false;cAuto.classList.remove('activeBtn');GF.record('🧪 AI Test stopped.')}
  };
  window.GFUX=GFUX;

  // Explicit game contract and test-harness separation.
  const proofBase=GFN.renderProof.bind(GFN);
  GFN.renderProof=function(){
    proofBase();
    const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='proofTestHarness';
    box.innerHTML=`<h3>TEST HARNESS — NOT THE PLAYER GAME</h3><p>Simulation operates both sides for balancing and proof. The main game remains one player versus the AI rival.</p><div class="forgeActions"><button id="proofStartDemo">WATCH AI TEST</button><button id="proofStopDemo">STOP TEST</button></div><div class="routeProof">GAME: ${GFN.esc(GFUX.info().game)}\nENGINE: GameForge\nINPUT LOOP: ${GFN.esc(GFUX.info().input)}\nPLAY LOOP: ${GFN.esc(GFUX.info().play)}\nPLAYER COUNT: 1 Player vs Rival AI\nWIN: ${GFN.esc(GFUX.info().win)}</div>`;
    forgeBody.appendChild(box);proofStartDemo.onclick=()=>GFUX.startDemo();proofStopDemo.onclick=()=>GFUX.stopDemo();
  };

  // Body selection returns to an explicit game-start state.

  };

  };
  const rivalBase=GFPLAY.rivalTurn.bind(GFPLAY);
  GFPLAY.rivalTurn=function(){GFUX.showIntent(this.decideRival());const r=rivalBase();setTimeout(()=>GFUX.sync(),this.save.settings.reduceMotion?80:900);return r};

  // Player input is a deliberate contact on the active character.
  GF.bind=function(){
    const pos=e=>{const r=this.cv.getBoundingClientRect(),p=e.touches?e.touches[0]:e;return{x:(p.clientX-r.left)*this.w/r.width,y:(p.clientY-r.top)*this.h/r.height}};
    this.cv.onpointerdown=e=>{
      if(GFN.edit||this.winner)return;
      if(!GFUX.matchStarted)return GFUX.block('Press START 1P GAME first.');
      if(this.turn!=='P1'||GFPLAY.rivalBusy)return GFUX.block('It is the rival turn.');

    };

      if(!this.drag||this.winner||GFN.edit)return;
      if(!GFUX.matchStarted||this.turn!=='P1'){this.drag=null;return}

      c.save();c.strokeStyle='#8ff7ffcc';c.lineWidth=3;c.setLineDash([8,7]);c.beginPath();c.arc(this.player.x,this.player.y,this.player.r+14+Math.sin(performance.now()/260)*4,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();c.setLineDash([]);c.fillStyle='#dffbff';c.font='bold 15px system-ui';c.fillText('TOUCH + DRAG',this.player.x-52,this.player.y-this.player.r-24);c.restore();

  cEnd.onclick=()=>GF.endTurn();
  start1PMatch.onclick=()=>GFUX.start(false);

<script id="tboys-final-graft-v01">
(() => {
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const overlays = ['tbHomeOverlay','tbCrewOverlay','tbHowOverlay'];
  const show = id => {
    overlays.forEach(x => { const n=$(x); if(n) n.hidden = x !== id; });
  };
  const closeAll = () => overlays.forEach(x => { const n=$(x); if(n) n.hidden = true; });

  function lockTboys(){
    if(window.GF && GF.body?.id !== 'tboys') GF.applyBody('tboys', false);
    document.body.classList.remove('engineLabOpen');
    const badge=$('tbModeBadge'); if(badge) badge.textContent='PLAYER MODE · T‑BOYS ONLY';
  }

  function renderCrew(){
    const grid=$('tbCrewGrid');
    if(!grid || !window.GF) return;
    grid.innerHTML='';
    GF.pCrew.forEach((m,i)=>{
      const card=document.createElement('button');
      card.className='crewCard '+(i===GF.pActive?'active':'');
      card.innerHTML=`<span class="crewIcon" style="color:${m.color}">${m.icon}</span><b>${m.n}</b><span>${m.trait}</span>`;
      card.onclick=()=>{
        GF.setActive('P1',i);
        renderCrew();
        GF.showBanner(m.n.toUpperCase()+' · '+m.trait.toUpperCase());
      };
      grid.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  function openCampaign(){
    closeAll();
    lockTboys();
    if(window.GFN){
      GFN.tab='campaign';
      GFN.openForge('campaign');
    }
  }

  function toggleLab(){
    closeAll();
    document.body.classList.toggle('engineLabOpen');
    const open=document.body.classList.contains('engineLabOpen');
    const badge=$('tbModeBadge');
    if(badge) badge.textContent=open?'ENGINE LAB · DONOR BODIES VISIBLE':'PLAYER MODE · T‑BOYS ONLY';
    if(!open) lockTboys();
    if(window.GF) GF.showBanner(open?'ENGINE LAB OPEN':'T‑BOYS PLAYER MODE');
  }

  function quickPlay(){
    closeAll();
    lockTboys();
    setTimeout(()=> $('start1PMatch')?.click(), 40);
  }

  $('tbHomeBtn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>show('tbHomeOverlay'));
  $('tbCrewBtn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{renderCrew();show('tbCrewOverlay')});
  $('tbCampaignBtn')?.addEventListener('click',openCampaign);
  $('tbHowBtn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>show('tbHowOverlay'));
  $('tbLabBtn')?.addEventListener('click',toggleLab);
  $('tbQuickPlay')?.addEventListener('click',quickPlay);
  $('tbHomeCrew')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{renderCrew();show('tbCrewOverlay')});
  $('tbHomeCampaign')?.addEventListener('click',openCampaign);
  $('tbHomeHow')?.addEventListener('click',()=>show('tbHowOverlay'));
  $('tbHomeLab')?.addEventListener('click',toggleLab);
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-close-overlay]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',closeAll));

  // Product-facing return route overrides the old generic game-list route.
  $('returnGameList')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    lockTboys();
    show('tbHomeOverlay');
  }, true);

  // Keep the source engine available, but prevent accidental identity drift in player mode.
  const originalApply = window.GF?.applyBody?.bind(GF);
  if(originalApply){
    GF.applyBody = function(id, announce=true){
      if(!document.body.classList.contains('engineLabOpen') && id !== 'tboys') id='tboys';
      return originalApply(id, announce);
    };
  }

  setTimeout(()=>{
    document.title='T-Boys: Core Clash — Final Graft Product Candidate v0.1';
    lockTboys();
    renderCrew();
    const contract=$('contractGame'); if(contract) contract.textContent='T‑Boys: Core Clash';
    const sub=document.querySelector('header .sub');
    if(sub) sub.textContent='Final Graft Candidate v0.1 · Powered by GameForge v3.16';
    if(window.GF) GF.record('🏁 T‑Boys Final Graft Candidate v0.1 mounted.');
  }, 60);
})();
</script>

<script>
'use strict';
const JM_PRIMEBODY_SOURCE = "PrimeBody {\n  TokenBody: @json64()\n  GlyphBody: crew=4; roster=8; silhouette=movement_word; passive=contact_consequence; signature=charged_active_power; field=living_escalation; bonds=visible_relationship; presets=suggestion_not_default; main=familiarity; rotation=inheritance; host=replaceable\n  RouteFrame: menu > suggested_crews > custom_crew > match_seed > inspect_body > select > charge_power > arm_signature > pull > aim > release > live_contact > passive_trigger > signature_consequence > field_shift > field_memory > settle > handover > receipt\n  StateField: match; turn; phase; units; health; velocity; silhouette; passive_state; signature_charge; signature_armed; signature_spent; field_mode; marks; tension_fields; root_fields; route_chain; field_memory; familiarity; crew_cycle; battle_sentence; rival_trace\n  ContactBand: inspect; charge; ready; arm; signature; hitstop; wall; spring; pulse_bloom; ally; enemy; relay; mark; tension; root; faultline; supernova; backdoor; fortress; damage; defeat\n  FormulaGate: source_valid && crew_complete && route_authorised -> execute; suggestion_selected -> load_not_force; else -> honest_hold_receipt\n  Output: JMActionPacket + TraceBoxReceipt + AbilityTriggerReceipt + SignaturePowerReceipt + LivingFieldReceipt + RivalPowerIntent + AbilityLens + FieldMemory + RelationshipSignal + PresetSuggestion + SaveState\n  PunctBody: :: -> || !! [] {}\n}";
const REQUIRED_ORGANS=['TokenBody','GlyphBody','RouteFrame','StateField','ContactBand','FormulaGate','Output','PunctBody'];
function parsePrimeBody(raw){
  const lines=String(raw||'').split(/\r?\n/), organs={}, failures=[];
  const first=lines.findIndex(x=>x.trim());
  if(first<0||lines[first].trim()!=='PrimeBody {') failures.push('HEADER_MISSING');
  if(!lines.some(x=>x.trim()==='}')) failures.push('CLOSING_BODY_MISSING');
  for(let i=first+1;i<lines.length;i++){
    const line=lines[i].trim(); if(!line||line==='}') continue;
    const m=line.match(/^([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*:\s*(.+)$/); if(!m){failures.push('UNREADABLE_LINE_'+(i+1));continue}
    organs[m[1]]=m[2];
  }
  for(const n of REQUIRED_ORGANS) if(!organs[n]) failures.push('MISSING_'+n.toUpperCase());
  let token=null;
  if(organs.TokenBody){const m=organs.TokenBody.match(/^@json64\((.+)\)$/);if(!m)failures.push('TOKEN_ENCODING_INVALID');else try{token=JSON.parse(atob(m[1]))}catch(e){failures.push('TOKEN_DECODE_FAILED')}}
  return {kind:'PrimeBodyParse.v0.5-Crewbound',status:failures.length?'failed':'success',build_permission:!failures.length,organs,token,failures};
}
function transformPrimeBodyToGameIR(ding){
  if(!ding.build_permission) return {status:'failed',failure:'SOURCE_NOT_AUTHORISED'};
  const t=ding.token;
  return {status:'success',kind:'JMGameIR.v0.5-Crewbound',meta:{source_kind:'PrimeBody',schema:t.schema,identity:t.identity,route:ding.organs.RouteFrame,punctuation:ding.organs.PunctBody},rules:t.rules,arena:t.arena,fighters:Object.fromEntries(t.fighters.map(f=>[f.key,Object.freeze(f)])),fighterOrder:t.fighters.map(f=>f.key),presets:t.presets||[],relationships:t.relationships||[],output:ding.organs.Output};
}
const PARSE_DING=parsePrimeBody(JM_PRIMEBODY_SOURCE);
const JM_IR=transformPrimeBodyToGameIR(PARSE_DING);

const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v)); const TAU=Math.PI*2;

const SAVE_KEY='JM_CREWBOUND_SIGNATURE_FIELD_v0_5';
let save=(()=>{try{return JSON.parse(safeStore.get(SAVE_KEY,safeStore.get('JM_CREWBOUND_ABILITY_CONTACT_v0_4',safeStore.get('JM_CREWBOUND_BODIES_BONDS_v0_3',safeStore.get('JM_CREWBOUND_BOUNCE_JUICE_v0_2',safeStore.get('JM_CREWBOUND_FOUNDATION_v0_1',''))))))||{}}catch{return {}}})();
save.crew=Array.isArray(save.crew)&&save.crew.length===4?save.crew:['ZIPP','BRAX','MIRA','ORBI']; save.stats=save.stats||{wins:0,losses:0,bestCombo:0,shots:0}; save.sound=save.sound!==false; save.lastPreset=save.lastPreset||null;
function persist(){safeStore.set(SAVE_KEY,JSON.stringify(save));updateMenuStats()}

let audioCtx=null; function tone(freq=300,dur=.06,type='sine',gain=.035){if(!save.sound)return;try{audioCtx=audioCtx||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();const o=audioCtx.createOscillator(),g=audioCtx.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.value=freq;g.gain.setValueAtTime(gain,audioCtx.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,audioCtx.currentTime+dur);o.connect(g).connect(audioCtx.destination);o.start();o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+dur)}catch{}}
function haptic(p=15){try{navigator.vibrate?.(p)}catch{}}

const faceGlyph={dart:'➤',brick:'▣',wisp:'◉',shard:'◆',guardian:'♜',star:'✹',twin:'∞',split:'↯'};
const portraitCache={};
function portraitURI(f){
 if(portraitCache[f.key])return portraitCache[f.key];
 const fill=`url(#g)`,stroke=f.palette[2];let body='';
 if(f.shape==='dart')body=`<path d="M10 54 66 12 58 39 90 50 58 61 66 88z" fill="${fill}" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="5"/>`;

 if(f.shape==='wisp')body=`<ellipse cx="50" cy="51" rx="30" ry="39" fill="${fill}" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="5"/><ellipse cx="50" cy="51" rx="43" ry="20" fill="none" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="5" opacity=".75" transform="rotate(-20 50 51)"/>`;
 if(f.shape==='shard')body=`<path d="m50 7 35 25-12 50-23 12-25-12L14 32z" fill="${fill}" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="5"/><path d="m50 7 4 75-29 0z" fill="#fff" opacity=".18"/>`;
 if(f.shape==='guardian')body=`<path d="M22 35 11 17l22 10L50 8l17 19 22-10-11 18 8 43-19 14H33L14 78z" fill="${fill}" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="6"/><path d="M28 76 19 96M50 78v19M72 76l9 20" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="7"/>`;
 if(f.shape==='star')body=`<path d="m50 4 10 24 22-14-7 26 27 2-23 15 19 18-27-5-3 27-14-23-18 20 3-27-27 7 18-20L5 41l27-3-9-25 23 13z" fill="${fill}" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="4"/>`;
 if(f.shape==='twin')body=`<ellipse cx="33" cy="52" rx="25" ry="31" fill="${fill}" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="5"/><ellipse cx="67" cy="52" rx="25" ry="31" fill="${fill}" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M35 52h30" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="9"/>`;

const baseEndShot=Runtime.endShot;
Runtime.endShot=function(){
 const st=this.state,s=st?.shot,actor=s&&this.unit(s.actorId);if(!s)return baseEndShot.call(this);
 if(actor?.alive&&s.signature==='MIRA'){
   const touched=(actor.signatureTouched||[]).map(id=>this.unit(id)).filter(Boolean);
   const receiver=touched.sort((a,b)=>b.maxHp-a.maxHp)[0]||this.living(s.owner).filter(x=>x.id!==actor.id).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-actor.x,a.y-actor.y)-Math.hypot(b.x-actor.x,b.y-actor.y))[0];
   if(receiver){receiver.relay=true;receiver.echoCharges=2;receiver.shield=Math.max(receiver.shield,160);signatureSignal(actor,'MIRROR ROUTE',`${receiver.name} carries the route into the next turn`,'#ff91ec')}
 }
 if(actor?.alive&&s.signature==='GROVE'){
   const allies=this.living(s.owner);for(const a of allies){a.shield=Math.max(a.shield,JM_IR.rules.fortress_shield);ring(a.x,a.y,a.r+35,'#baff78',.7)}
   st.rootFields.push({team:s.owner,x:actor.x,y:actor.y,r:265,life:4,signature:true});st.fortressTurns[s.owner]=2;
   signatureSignal(actor,'FORTRESS ROOT',`${allies.length} bodies shielded · return pressure armed`,'#bdff72');
 }
 const owner=s.owner;baseEndShot.call(this);
 if(!this.state||this.state.ended)return;
 const protectedTeam=owner==='player'?'enemy':'player';if(this.state.fortressTurns[protectedTeam]>0)this.state.fortressTurns[protectedTeam]--;
 if(this.state.stats.turns>0&&this.state.stats.turns%(JM_IR.rules.field_shift_every||3)===0){
   this.state.fieldModeIndex=(this.state.fieldModeIndex+1)%FIELD_MODES.length;this.state.fieldShiftCount++;
   const m=mode();renderFieldMode();banner(`FIELD SHIFT · ${m.name}`,m.line,1050);tone(430+this.state.fieldModeIndex*110,.14,'triangle',.055);haptic([14,24,14]);
   this.receipt('LIVING_FIELD_SHIFT',{mode:m.id,name:m.name,turn:this.state.stats.turns,shift:this.state.fieldShiftCount});
 }
 this.updateUI();
};

const baseStep=Runtime.step;
Runtime.step=function(dt){
 const st=this.state;if(!st)return;
 if(st.hitStop>0){st.hitStop=Math.max(0,st.hitStop-dt);return}
 if(st.phase==='moving'&&st.shot){
   const actor=this.unit(st.shot.actorId);
   if(mode().id==='GRAVITY'){
     const o=JM_IR.arena.obstacle;
     for(const u of this.living('player').concat(this.living('enemy'))){const dx=o.x-u.x,dy=o.y-u.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,force=(JM_IR.rules.gravity_bloom_pull||90)*dt;u.vx+=dx/d*force;u.vy+=dy/d*force}
   }
   if(st.shot.signature==='KNOT'&&actor?.alive&&actor.weblockReady&&Math.hypot(actor.vx,actor.vy)>100){
     const last=actor.signatureTrailLast||{x:actor.x,y:actor.y};
     if(Math.hypot(actor.x-last.x,actor.y-last.y)>105){
       actor.signatureTrailLast={x:actor.x,y:actor.y};st.tensionFields.push({team:actor.team,x:actor.x,y:actor.y,r:92,life:3,signature:true});st.tensionFields=st.tensionFields.slice(-12);
       ring(actor.x,actor.y,84,'#68efb9',.28);pop(actor.x,actor.y,'WEB NODE','#dfff8a',9);
     }
   }
 }
 baseStep.call(this,dt);
};

const baseDrawArena=drawArena;
drawArena=function(){
 baseDrawArena();const st=Runtime.state;if(!st)return;const m=mode(),t=performance.now()/1000,o=JM_IR.arena.obstacle;
 ctx.save();
 if(m.id==='SPRING'){ctx.globalAlpha=.16+.04*Math.sin(t*4);ctx.strokeStyle='#65edff';ctx.lineWidth=7;ctx.setLineDash([14,14]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x,o.y,270+Math.sin(t*2)*12,0,TAU);ctx.stroke()}
 if(m.id==='GRAVITY'){ctx.globalAlpha=.18;ctx.strokeStyle='#ee8cff';ctx.lineWidth=5;for(let i=0;i<4;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x,o.y,145+i*72-(t*18)%72,0,TAU);ctx.stroke()}}
 if(m.id==='OVERDRIVE'){ctx.globalAlpha=.2+.07*Math.sin(t*7);ctx.strokeStyle='#ffe36b';ctx.lineWidth=10;const b=JM_IR.arena.bounds;roundRect(ctx,b.x+5,b.y+5,b.w-10,b.h-10,b.radius-5);ctx.stroke()}
 ctx.restore();
};
const baseDraw=draw;
draw=function(){
 baseDraw();const st=Runtime.state;if(!st)return;const t=performance.now()/1000;
 ctx.save();
 for(const u of st.units.filter(x=>x.alive&&(x.signatureArmed||(x.signatureCharge||0)>=SIG_MAX))){
   const f=JM_IR.fighters[u.key],armed=u.signatureArmed;
   ctx.globalAlpha=armed?.85:.42;ctx.strokeStyle=armed?'#fff49a':f.palette[0];ctx.lineWidth=armed?7:4;ctx.setLineDash(armed?[13,7]:[6,10]);ctx.translate(u.x,u.y);ctx.rotate(t*(armed?2.4:1.1));ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,u.r+24+Math.sin(t*6)*4,0,TAU);ctx.stroke();ctx.rotate(-t*(armed?2.4:1.1));ctx.translate(-u.x,-u.y);
 }
 ctx.restore();
};

const baseAbilityStatus=abilityStatus;
abilityStatus=function(u,f){
 const passive=baseAbilityStatus(u,f);if(!u)return passive;
 const p=Math.round(u.signatureCharge||0);return `${passive} · POWER ${u.signatureArmed?'ARMED':p>=SIG_MAX?'READY':p+'%'}`;
};

renderFieldMode();
Runtime.updateUI?.();
})();
</script>

</body></html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover" />
<title>GlyphPlay B1 v29.1 — Contact and Density</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#080b12;--line:#2b3550;--text:#f4f7ff;--muted:#9ca7bd;--panel:#111827;--panel2:#1b2234;--cyan:#8ff7ff;--green:#9bea9f;--gold:#ffd37a;--red:#ff6c7a;--purple:#caa7ff}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif}
body{padding:8px;min-height:100vh}
.app{max-width:830px;margin:0 auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0e1422,#090c14);padding:10px}
h1{font-size:1.05rem;margin:0 0 6px}
.credit{font-family:"Courier New",monospace;font-size:.58rem;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 9px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.credit strong{color:var(--green)}
.hud{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:8px}
.hud div{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;background:#0d1320;padding:5px;text-align:center;min-height:42px}
.hud span{display:block;font-size:.59rem;color:var(--muted)}
.hud strong{display:block;font-size:.74rem;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.projectBar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 68px 68px;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;border:1px solid rgba(155,234,159,.18);border-radius:14px;padding:6px;background:rgba(155,234,159,.035)}
.projectBar input{min-width:0;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text);padding:6px;font-size:.7rem}
.projectBar button{font-size:.58rem;min-height:32px}
.tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:5px;margin-top:8px;border:1px solid rgba(143,247,255,.18);border-radius:14px;padding:6px}
button{background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;min-height:34px;font-size:.66rem}
button.active{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green);background:rgba(155,234,159,.11)}
.fieldWrap{margin-top:8px;border:1px solid rgba(143,247,255,.25);border-radius:16px;padding:8px;background:#05070c;min-height:230px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.field{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(16,1fr);gap:3px;touch-action:none}
.cell{aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid #1d263b;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:"Courier New",monospace;font-weight:800;font-size:.6rem;background:#090d16;color:#44506c;position:relative;user-select:none;transition:transform .12s ease,border-color .12s ease,box-shadow .12s ease,background .12s ease}
.cell .hp{position:absolute;left:1px;top:0;font-size:.37rem;color:var(--red)}
.cell .beh{position:absolute;right:1px;bottom:0;font-size:.38rem;color:var(--cyan)}
.cell.player{color:var(--green);border-color:rgba(155,234,159,.8);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(155,234,159,.22)}
.cell.wall{color:#ff858f;border-color:rgba(255,108,122,.55)}
.cell.goal{color:#9ec7ff;border-color:rgba(158,199,255,.65)}
.cell.coin{color:var(--gold);border-color:rgba(255,211,122,.65)}
.cell.enemy{color:var(--purple);border-color:rgba(202,167,255,.65)}
.cell.hazard{color:var(--red);border-color:rgba(255,108,122,.65)}
.cell.heart{color:#ff9ab3;border-color:rgba(255,154,179,.72)}
.cell.custom{color:#aaf4ff;border-color:rgba(143,247,255,.72)}
.cell.cursor{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,211,122,.55) inset}
.cell.target{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,108,122,.75) inset,0 0 12px rgba(255,108,122,.25)}
.cell.selected{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(143,247,255,.65) inset,0 0 12px rgba(143,247,255,.22)}
.cell.flash-hit{animation:hitPulse .38s ease}
.cell.flash-heal{animation:healPulse .42s ease}
.cell.flash-score{animation:scorePulse .42s ease}
.cell.trail{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(143,247,255,.35) inset,0 0 12px rgba(143,247,255,.2)}
@keyframes hitPulse{0%{transform:scale(1);background:#090d16}45%{transform:scale(1.18);background:rgba(255,108,122,.24);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,108,122,.38)}100%{transform:scale(1);background:#090d16}}
@keyframes healPulse{0%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.14);background:rgba(155,234,159,.24);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(155,234,159,.38)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
@keyframes scorePulse{0%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.12);background:rgba(255,211,122,.22);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,211,122,.38)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.pop{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;font-family:"Courier New",monospace;font-weight:900;font-size:.72rem;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #000;animation:floatPop .85s ease forwards;z-index:4}
.pop.damage{color:var(--red)}.pop.heal{color:var(--green)}.pop.score{color:var(--gold)}.pop.action{color:var(--cyan)}
@keyframes floatPop{0%{transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(.85);opacity:0}18%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translate(-50%,-28px) scale(1.08);opacity:0}}
.banner{position:absolute;inset:8px;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:6;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(5,7,12,.72);border:1px solid rgba(143,247,255,.28);font-weight:900;font-size:1.6rem;letter-spacing:.03em;text-align:center;text-shadow:0 2px 12px #000}
.banner.show{display:flex;animation:bannerPulse .8s ease}
.banner.win{color:var(--green)}.banner.fail{color:var(--red)}
@keyframes bannerPulse{0%{transform:scale(.95);opacity:0}100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
.builder{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 114px;gap:7px;margin-top:8px}
.inspector{border:1px solid rgba(255,211,122,.32);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,211,122,.045);padding:7px;min-height:286px;max-height:410px;overflow:auto}
.inspector h2{font-size:.78rem;margin:0 0 5px;color:var(--gold)}
.status{font-family:"Courier New",monospace;color:var(--cyan);font-size:.61rem;line-height:1.35;white-space:pre-wrap}
.palette{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;margin-top:7px}
.palette button{min-height:27px;font-size:.47rem;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 7px}
.palette button.sel{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);background:rgba(255,211,122,.09)}
.ruleGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px;margin-top:6px}
.ruleGrid button{min-height:28px;font-size:.39rem;border-radius:8px}
.listBox{border:1px solid rgba(143,247,255,.16);border-radius:10px;padding:5px;margin-top:6px;background:rgba(143,247,255,.035);font-family:"Courier New",monospace;font-size:.46rem;color:#d8e6ff;max-height:92px;overflow:auto}
.props{border:1px solid rgba(155,234,159,.16);border-radius:10px;padding:5px;margin-top:6px;background:rgba(155,234,159,.035);font-family:"Courier New",monospace;font-size:.46rem;color:#d8ffe0;max-height:88px;overflow:auto}
.rules{font-family:"Courier New",monospace;color:var(--muted);font-size:.5rem;margin-top:7px;line-height:1.35}
.dock{border:1px solid rgba(143,247,255,.22);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(143,247,255,.04);padding:5px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px;align-content:start}
.dock .label{grid-column:1/4;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-family:"Courier New",monospace;font-size:.5rem;letter-spacing:.08em}
.dock button{min-height:31px;font-size:.82rem;border-radius:9px;padding:0}
.dock .knob{border-color:var(--cyan);color:var(--cyan)}
.dock .wide{grid-column:1/4;font-size:.52rem;min-height:29px}
.command{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr 52px;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;border:1px solid rgba(143,247,255,.25);border-radius:14px;padding:6px;align-items:center}
.command label{font-weight:700;color:var(--cyan);font-size:.68rem;white-space:nowrap}
.command input{min-height:36px;min-width:0;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text);padding:6px;font-size:.7rem}
.small{font-size:.52rem;color:var(--muted);font-family:"Courier New",monospace;margin-top:5px}
@media(max-width:580px){.hud{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.tabs{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.builder{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 106px}.field{gap:2px}.cell{font-size:.48rem}.command{grid-template-columns:1fr 46px}.command label{grid-column:1/3}.ruleGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}

.fieldWrap.shake{animation:screenShake .28s ease}
@keyframes screenShake{0%{transform:translateX(0)}20%{transform:translateX(-4px)}40%{transform:translateX(4px)}60%{transform:translateX(-3px)}80%{transform:translateX(3px)}100%{transform:translateX(0)}}
.burst{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 10px currentColor;animation:burstOut .7s ease forwards;z-index:5}
.burst.damage{background:var(--red);color:var(--red)}.burst.heal{background:var(--green);color:var(--green)}.burst.score{background:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}.burst.action{background:var(--cyan);color:var(--cyan)}
@keyframes burstOut{0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.4);opacity:1}100%{transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--dx)),calc(-50% + var(--dy))) scale(.1);opacity:0}}
.feelLine{margin-top:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,211,122,.18);border-radius:10px;padding:5px;background:rgba(255,211,122,.04);font-family:"Courier New",monospace;font-size:.55rem;color:var(--gold)}
.banner small{display:block;font-size:.62rem;color:var(--cyan);margin-top:8px;font-weight:700}


.onboardBox{border:1px solid rgba(143,247,255,.18);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(143,247,255,.035);padding:6px;margin-top:6px;font-family:"Courier New",monospace;font-size:.5rem;color:#d8faff;line-height:1.35;max-height:116px;overflow:auto}
.onboardBox b{color:var(--gold)}
.routePill{display:inline-block;border:1px solid rgba(255,211,122,.28);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 6px;margin:2px;color:var(--gold);background:rgba(255,211,122,.05)}


.templateGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:4px;margin-top:6px}
.templateGrid button{font-size:.45rem;min-height:29px}
.intentBox{border:1px solid rgba(155,234,159,.18);border-radius:10px;padding:5px;margin-top:6px;background:rgba(155,234,159,.04);font-family:"Courier New",monospace;font-size:.5rem;color:#dfffe1;line-height:1.35}
.intentBox b{color:var(--green)}


.actionLibrary{margin-top:7px;border:1px solid rgba(143,247,255,.16);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(143,247,255,.035);padding:5px}
.actionLibrary details{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.12);margin:4px 0;padding:4px}
.actionLibrary summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--gold);font-family:"Courier New",monospace;font-size:.55rem;font-weight:800;list-style:none}
.actionLibrary summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}

/* v27.2A compact graft methods */
Object.assign(GP,{
  v272aDeck:{
    capture:"make a 3v3 capture the flag game",
    tag:"make a tag chase game",
    boxing:"make a 1v1 boxing game",
    goal:"make a 3v3 goal ball game",
    rebound:"make a rebound arena game",
    plain:"make a 3v3 plain battle",
    survival:"make a survival room",
    card:"make a 1v1 TCG card battle"
  },
  v272aAimMode:"pull",
  v272aEntityIndex:0,
  v272aEntityControl:false,
  v272aDefault(kind){
    const prompt=this.v272aDeck[kind]||this.v272aDeck.capture;
    const line=document.getElementById("v272aDeckLine");
    if(line)line.textContent="Default generated: "+prompt;
    this.generateIntent(prompt);
  },
  v272aAim(mode){
    this.v272aAimMode=mode;
    const labels={pull:"Pull Aim: tension/release route.",drag:"Drag Aim: target/cursor route.",fire:"Fire: direct action route.",fling:"Fling: launch/rebound route."};
    if(mode==="fling")this.setControlStyle("FlickLaunch");
    else this.setControlStyle("DragAim");
    const line=document.getElementById("v272aAimLine");
    if(line)line.textContent=labels[mode]||"Aim changed.";
    this.smooth("Aim Type: "+mode+".",labels[mode]||"Aim changed.");
  },
  v272aObjects(){
    return this.objects().filter(o=>!o.props?.eliminated);
  },
  v272aCurrent(){
    const list=this.v272aObjects();
    if(!list.length)return null;
    this.v272aEntityIndex=((this.v272aEntityIndex||0)%list.length+list.length)%list.length;
    return list[this.v272aEntityIndex];
  },
  v272aSelect(step=1){
    const list=this.v272aObjects();
    if(!list.length){this.smooth("No entity available.","Generate a world first.");return null}
    this.v272aEntityIndex=((this.v272aEntityIndex||0)+step+list.length)%list.length;
    const e=this.v272aCurrent();
    this.selected=e; this.cursor={x:e.x,y:e.y}; this.target={x:e.x,y:e.y};
    this.v272aEntityLine(e,"Selected");
    this.render();
    return e;
  },
  v272aPick(){
    const o=this.topObjAt(this.cursor.x,this.cursor.y);
    if(!o){this.smooth("Nothing at cursor.","Move cursor over something, then Pick.");return null}
    const list=this.v272aObjects(); const i=list.indexOf(o);
    if(i>=0)this.v272aEntityIndex=i;
    this.selected=o;
    this.v272aEntityLine(o,"Picked");
    this.render();
    return o;
  },
  v272aControl(){
    const e=this.v272aCurrent()||this.v272aPick();
    if(!e)return;
    this.v272aEntityControl=!this.v272aEntityControl;
    this.control=this.v272aEntityControl?"ENTITY":"PLAYER";
    this.inputDeviceMode="ARROW";
    this.selected=e;
    this.v272aEntityLine(e,this.v272aEntityControl?"Controlling":"Control off");
    this.render();
  },
  v272aSpin(){
    const e=this.v272aCurrent()||this.v272aPick();
    if(!e)return;
    e.props.spin=((e.props.spin||0)+90)%360;
    this.selected=e;
    this.v272aEntityLine(e,"Spin "+e.props.spin+"°");
    this.render();
  },
  v272aInspect(){
    const e=this.v272aCurrent()||this.v272aPick();
    if(!e)return;
    this.selected=e;
    const props=Object.entries(e.props||{}).map(([k,v])=>k+"="+v).join(", ")||"no props";
    this.v272aEntityLine(e,"Inspect");
    this.smooth("Inspecting "+e.type,props);
    this.render();
  },
  v272aEntityLine(e,verb){
    const line=document.getElementById("v272aEntityLine");
    if(line&&e)line.textContent=verb+": "+e.type+" @ "+e.x+","+e.y+" · role "+this.roleOf(e);
  },
  generateCardBattle(raw){
    this.projectName="Generated Card Battle";
    this.arenaMode="CardBattle";
    this.setControlStyle("Move");
    const objects=[
      this.obj("Player",2,4,{hp:5,maxHp:5,team:"A"}),
      this.obj("TeamB",13,4,{hp:6,maxHp:6,damage:1,team:"B"}),
      this.obj("Deck",1,7,{team:"A"}),
      this.obj("Deck",14,1,{team:"B"}),
      this.obj("Card",5,6,{name:"Spark",cost:1,power:1}),
      this.obj("Card",6,6,{name:"Guard",cost:1,power:1,hp:2,maxHp:2}),
      this.obj("Card",7,6,{name:"Burst",cost:2,power:2}),
      this.obj("Mana",4,7,{mana:1}),
      this.obj("Mana",8,7,{mana:1}),
      this.obj("Zone",8,4,{zone:"battle"}),
      this.obj("Goal",14,4,{team:"B"})
    ];
    this.generatedScene("1v1 TCG / CCG Card Battle",{x:2,y:4},objects,{
      objects:["P = player avatar","enemy avatar","deck","cards","mana","battle zone"],
      rules:["select a card","inspect card","control/move pieces","use card power to damage enemy","clear enemy avatar to win"],
      controls:["Entity Keybox selects cards","Arrow Mode moves avatar/entity","Mouse Mode edits"],
      win:"Reduce enemy avatar HP to 0 or reach objective",
      fail:"Player avatar HP reaches 0"
    });
    this.setBrain(raw||"card battle","TCG / CCG Card Battle","1v1","card battle board");
    this.smooth("Built Card Battle seed.","Use Entity Keybox to select, inspect, spin or control cards.");
  }
});
/* Route card language without rewriting the full parser */
const _v272aGenerateLittleWordsWorld=GP.generateLittleWordsWorld.bind(GP);
GP.generateLittleWordsWorld=function(raw){
  const x=(raw||"").toLowerCase();
  if(x.includes("tcg")||x.includes("ccg")||x.includes("card battle")||x.includes("card game")||x.includes("deck builder")||x.includes("creature card"))return this.generateCardBattle(raw);
  if(x.includes("survival")||x.includes("survive"))return this.makeTemplate("survival");
  if(x.includes("key door")||x.includes("key-door")||x.includes("unlock door"))return this.makeTemplate("keydoor");
  return _v272aGenerateLittleWordsWorld(raw);
};
/* Make arrows control selected entities when Entity Control is on. */
const _v272aMove=GP.move.bind(GP);
GP.move=function(dx,dy){
  if(this.control==="ENTITY"&&this.v272aEntityControl){
    const e=this.v272aCurrent();
    if(!e)return this.smooth("No entity selected.","Use Entity Keybox.");
    const nx=Math.max(0,Math.min(this.w-1,e.x+dx));
    const ny=Math.max(0,Math.min(this.h-1,e.y+dy));
    e.x=nx; e.y=ny;
    this.cursor={x:nx,y:ny}; this.target={x:nx+dx,y:ny+dy}; this.selected=e;
    this.refreshRuntime("Moved entity: "+e.type);
    this.v272aEntityLine(e,"Moved");
    return this.render();
  }
  return _v272aMove(dx,dy);
};
/* Route command bar to aim/entity/card/default commands first. */
const _v272aCommand=GP.command.bind(GP);
GP.command=function(){
  const input=document.getElementById("cmd");
  const raw=(input?.value||"").trim();
  const x=raw.toLowerCase();
  if(x.includes("tcg")||x.includes("ccg")||x.includes("card")){this.generateCardBattle(raw); if(input)input.value=""; return}
  if(x.includes("pull")){this.v272aAim("pull"); if(input)input.value=""; return}
  if(x.includes("drag")){this.v272aAim("drag"); if(input)input.value=""; return}
  if(x.includes("fire")){this.v272aAim("fire"); this.useAction(); if(input)input.value=""; return}
  if(x.includes("fling")){this.v272aAim("fling"); this.useAction(); if(input)input.value=""; return}
  if(x.includes("next entity")||x.includes("next midge")||x.includes("next generated")){this.v272aSelect(1); if(input)input.value=""; return}
  if(x.includes("prev entity")||x.includes("previous entity")){this.v272aSelect(-1); if(input)input.value=""; return}
  if(x.includes("control entity")||x.includes("control midge")||x.includes("control generated")){this.v272aControl(); if(input)input.value=""; return}
  if(x.includes("pick entity")||x.includes("pick generated")){this.v272aPick(); if(input)input.value=""; return}
  if(x.includes("spin")||x.includes("rotate inspect")){this.v272aSpin(); if(input)input.value=""; return}
  return _v272aCommand();
};
/* Visual markers for selected/controlled entity and card world. */
const _v272aRender=GP.render.bind(GP);
GP.render=function(){
  _v272aRender();
  const fw=document.getElementById("fieldWrap");
  if(fw)fw.classList.toggle("cardWorld",this.arenaMode==="CardBattle");
  const line=document.getElementById("v272aDeckLine");
  if(line&&this.currentDefaultGame)line.textContent="Default focus: "+(this.currentDefaultGame?.().name||"Capture Flag")+" · Dodgeball parked for now.";
};


/* v27.2B screen-centric border drawer sync */
GP.v272bSyncBorder=function(){
  const aim=document.getElementById("screenAimModeTag");
  if(aim)aim.textContent=(this.v272aAimMode||"pull").toUpperCase();
  const create=document.getElementById("screenCreateModeTag");
  if(create)create.textContent=this.arenaMode||this.generatedGameType||"Default Deck";
  const ent=document.getElementById("screenEntityTag");
  const e=this.v272aCurrent?this.v272aCurrent():null;
  if(ent&&e)ent.textContent=(this.v272aEntityControl?"Controlling ":"Selected ")+e.type+" @ "+e.x+","+e.y;
};
const _v272bRender=GP.render.bind(GP);
GP.render=function(){
  _v272bRender();
  this.v272bSyncBorder();
  const cells=[...document.querySelectorAll(".cell")];
  const e=this.v272aCurrent?this.v272aCurrent():null;
  if(e){
    const idx=e.y*this.w+e.x;
    if(cells[idx]){
      cells[idx].classList.add(this.v272aEntityControl?"entityControl":"entitySelected");
    }
  }
};
const _v272bAim=GP.v272aAim?.bind(GP);
if(_v272bAim){
  GP.v272aAim=function(mode){
    _v272bAim(mode);
    this.v272bSyncBorder();
  };
}
const _v272bDefault=GP.v272aDefault?.bind(GP);
if(_v272bDefault){
  GP.v272aDefault=function(kind){
    _v272bDefault(kind);
    this.v272bSyncBorder();
  };
}
const _v272bSelect=GP.v272aSelect?.bind(GP);
if(_v272bSelect){
  GP.v272aSelect=function(step){
    const out=_v272bSelect(step);
    this.v272bSyncBorder();
    return out;
  };
}


/* v27.3 Megaform Adapter Core */
Object.assign(GP,{
  v273Version:"v27.3",
  v273VisualMode:"classic",
  v273Adapter:"core",
  v273AimReady:true,
  v273CardState:{
    active:false,deck:[],hand:[],discard:[],mana:0,maxMana:0,turn:"Player",phase:"start",selectedIndex:0,playerLife:25,enemyLife:25,log:"No card duel started."
  },
  v273CardPool(){
    return [
      {name:"Spark Cub",cost:1,power:1,hp:1,type:"creature",text:"Small creature. Fast pressure."},
      {name:"Guard Root",cost:1,power:0,hp:3,type:"creature",text:"Defender body. Holds route."},
      {name:"Burst Fang",cost:2,power:2,hp:1,type:"creature",text:"Stronger hit."},
      {name:"Route Shield",cost:2,power:0,hp:0,type:"effect",text:"Heal Player 2."},
      {name:"Mana Seed",cost:0,power:0,hp:0,type:"effect",text:"Gain 1 mana this turn."},
      {name:"Defender Strike",cost:3,power:3,hp:2,type:"creature",text:"Heavy pressure card."}
    ];
  },
  v273Shuffle(arr){
    const a=[...arr];
    for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}
    return a;
  },
  v273StartCardDuel(mode="standard"){
    this.generateCardBattle("make a 1v1 TCG card battle");
    this.arenaMode="CardBattle";
    this.v273Adapter=mode==="defender"?"Defender / TCG":"TCG / CCG";
    const pool=this.v273CardPool();
    let deck=[];
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++)deck=deck.concat(pool.map(c=>({...c,id:this.uid()})));
    this.v273CardState={active:true,deck:this.v273Shuffle(deck),hand:[],discard:[],mana:1,maxMana:1,turn:"Player",phase:"draw",selectedIndex:0,playerLife:25,enemyLife:25,log:"Duel started. Draw cards, play one, attack, end turn."};
    this.v273DrawCard(3,false);
    this.playerHP=25;this.maxHP=25;
    const enemy=this.objects().find(o=>o.type==="TeamB"||o.props?.team==="B");
    if(enemy){enemy.props.hp=25;enemy.props.maxHp=25;enemy.props.name="Enemy Defender";}
    this.v273UpdateCardLine("Card duel ready. Hand loaded.");
    this.refreshRuntime("TCG runtime ready.");
    this.render();
  },
  v273DrawCard(n=1,announce=true){
    const st=this.v273CardState;if(!st.active)this.v273StartCardDuel();
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      if(!st.deck.length){
        st.deck=this.v273Shuffle(st.discard);
        st.discard=[];
      }
      if(st.deck.length)st.hand.push(st.deck.shift());
    }
    st.phase="draw";st.log="Drew "+n+" card(s).";
    if(announce)this.smooth("Draw",st.log);
    this.v273UpdateCardLine(st.log);
    this.render();
  },
  v273PlayCard(index=0){
    const st=this.v273CardState;if(!st.active)this.v273StartCardDuel();
    if(!st.hand.length){this.smooth("No cards in hand.","Draw first.");return}
    index=Math.max(0,Math.min(st.hand.length-1,index||0));
    const card=st.hand[index];
    if(card.cost>st.mana){this.smooth("Not enough mana",card.name+" costs "+card.cost+".");st.log="Need more mana for "+card.name;this.v273UpdateCardLine(st.log);return}
    st.mana-=card.cost;
    st.hand.splice(index,1);
    if(card.type==="effect"){
      if(card.name==="Route Shield"){st.playerLife=Math.min(25,st.playerLife+2);this.playerHP=Math.min(this.maxHP,this.playerHP+2);st.log="Played Route Shield. Player healed."}
      else if(card.name==="Mana Seed"){st.mana+=1;st.log="Played Mana Seed. Mana gained."}
      else {st.enemyLife=Math.max(0,st.enemyLife-(card.power||1));st.log="Played effect: "+card.name}
      st.discard.push(card);
    }else{
      const slotX=6+Math.min(4,this.objects().filter(o=>o.type==="Creature"&&o.props?.team==="A"&&!o.props?.eliminated).length);
      const creature=this.obj("Creature",slotX,5,{name:card.name,hp:card.hp,maxHp:card.hp,power:card.power,cost:card.cost,team:"A",cardText:card.text});
      this.objects().push(creature);
      this.selected=creature;
      st.log="Summoned "+card.name+" ("+card.power+"/"+card.hp+").";
    }
    this.v273UpdateCardLine(st.log);
    this.markCreatorChange("played card");
    this.checkRuntimeWinFail();
    this.render();
  },
  v273AttackWithCard(){
    const st=this.v273CardState;if(!st.active)this.v273StartCardDuel();
    const attacker=this.objects().find(o=>o.type==="Creature"&&o.props?.team==="A"&&!o.props?.eliminated);
    if(!attacker){this.smooth("No creature ready.","Play a creature card first.");return}
    const power=attacker.props.power||1;
    st.enemyLife=Math.max(0,st.enemyLife-power);
    const enemy=this.objects().find(o=>o.props?.team==="B"||o.type==="TeamB");
    if(enemy){enemy.props.hp=Math.max(0,(enemy.props.hp||25)-power);if(enemy.props.hp<=0)enemy.props.eliminated=true;}
    this.score+=power;
    st.log=attacker.props.name+" attacked for "+power+". Enemy life: "+st.enemyLife+".";
    this.flashAt(attacker.x,attacker.y,"action","ATK");
    this.burstAt(attacker.x,attacker.y,"damage",8);
    if(st.enemyLife<=0){this.state="WIN";this.showBanner("WIN<br><small>Card duel won</small>","win");st.log="Enemy Defender defeated. WIN.";}
    this.v273UpdateCardLine(st.log);
    this.refreshRuntime(st.log);
    this.render();
  },
  v273EndTurn(){
    const st=this.v273CardState;if(!st.active)this.v273StartCardDuel();
    st.turn="Opponent";st.phase="enemy";
    const enemyHit=Math.max(1,Math.min(3,Math.ceil(Math.random()*2)));
    st.playerLife=Math.max(0,st.playerLife-enemyHit);
    this.playerHP=Math.max(0,this.playerHP-enemyHit);
    st.maxMana=Math.min(8,st.maxMana+1);
    st.mana=st.maxMana;
    this.v273DrawCard(1,false);
    st.turn="Player";st.phase="main";
    st.log="Opponent hit for "+enemyHit+". New turn: mana "+st.mana+"/"+st.maxMana+".";
    if(st.playerLife<=0||this.playerHP<=0){this.state="FAIL";this.showBanner("FAIL<br><small>Player Defender fell</small>","fail");st.log="Player Defender fell. FAIL.";}
    this.v273UpdateCardLine(st.log);
    this.refreshRuntime(st.log);
    this.render();
  },
  v273UpdateCardLine(msg){
    const st=this.v273CardState;
    const line=document.getElementById("v273CardLine");
    if(line)line.innerHTML="<b>Card:</b> "+(msg||st.log)+"<br>Hand: "+st.hand.map((c,i)=>(i+1)+":"+c.name+"["+c.cost+"]").join(" · ");
    const tag=document.getElementById("v273CardTag");
    if(tag)tag.textContent="Deck "+st.deck.length+" · Hand "+st.hand.length+" · Mana "+st.mana+"/"+st.maxMana;
    const hud=document.getElementById("v273CardHud");
    if(hud)hud.innerHTML=`<div><b>Deck</b><br>${st.deck.length}</div><div><b>Hand</b><br>${st.hand.length}</div><div><b>Mana</b><br>${st.mana}/${st.maxMana}</div><div><b>Life</b><br>${st.playerLife}/${st.enemyLife}</div>`;
  },
  v273CurrentEntity(){
    return (this.v272aCurrent&&this.v272aCurrent())||this.selected||this.getPlayer();
  },
  v273RenameEntity(){
    const e=this.v273CurrentEntity();if(!e)return this.smooth("No entity selected.","Pick an entity first.");
    const old=e.props.name||e.type;
    const name=prompt("Rename entity:",old);
    if(!name)return;
    e.props.name=name;
    this.v273EntityMsg("Renamed "+old+" → "+name);
    this.render();
  },
  v273DuplicateEntity(){
    const e=this.v273CurrentEntity();if(!e)return this.smooth("No entity selected.","Pick an entity first.");
    const copy=this.obj(e.type,Math.min(this.w-1,e.x+1),e.y,{...(e.props||{})});
    this.objects().push(copy);
    this.selected=copy;
    this.v273EntityMsg("Duplicated "+e.type);
    this.render();
  },
  v273DeleteEntity(){
    const e=this.v273CurrentEntity();if(!e)return this.smooth("No entity selected.","Pick an entity first.");
    if(e.type==="Player"&&!confirm("Delete Player?"))return;
    this.removeObj(e);
    this.selected=null;
    this.v273EntityMsg("Deleted "+e.type);
    this.render();
  },
  v273ChangeHP(delta){
    const e=this.v273CurrentEntity();if(!e)return this.smooth("No entity selected.","Pick an entity first.");
    e.props.hp=(e.props.hp??e.props.maxHp??1)+delta;
    e.props.maxHp=Math.max(e.props.maxHp||e.props.hp,e.props.hp);
    if(e.props.hp<=0)e.props.eliminated=true;
    else e.props.eliminated=false;
    this.v273EntityMsg(e.type+" HP now "+e.props.hp);
    this.render();
  },
  v273ToggleTeam(){
    const e=this.v273CurrentEntity();if(!e)return this.smooth("No entity selected.","Pick an entity first.");
    e.props.team=e.props.team==="A"?"B":"A";
    this.v273EntityMsg(e.type+" team now "+e.props.team);
    this.render();
  },
  v273TurnInto(){
    const e=this.v273CurrentEntity();if(!e)return this.smooth("No entity selected.","Pick an entity first.");
    const t=prompt("Turn into type:",e.type);
    if(!t)return;
    if(!this.def(t)){this.smooth("Unknown type",t+" is not a known type yet.");return}
    e.type=this.cap(t);
    e.props={...(this.def(e.type).props||{}),name:e.props.name||e.type};
    this.v273EntityMsg("Turned entity into "+e.type);
    this.render();
  },
  v273Behaviour(kind){
    const e=this.v273CurrentEntity();if(!e)return this.smooth("No entity selected.","Pick an entity first.");
    e.props.behaviour=kind;
    e.props.actor=true;
    this.v273EntityMsg(e.type+" behaviour: "+kind);
    this.render();
  },
  v273InspectDeep(){
    const e=this.v273CurrentEntity();if(!e)return this.smooth("No entity selected.","Pick an entity first.");
    const d=this.def(e.type)||{};
    this.v273EntityMsg("Inspect "+(e.props.name||e.type)+" · role="+(d.role||"custom")+" · props="+JSON.stringify(e.props||{}));
    this.smooth("Deep Inspect: "+(e.props.name||e.type),JSON.stringify(e.props||{}));
  },
  v273EntityMsg(msg){
    const line=document.getElementById("v273EditLine");if(line)line.innerHTML="<b>Edit:</b> "+msg;
    const tag=document.getElementById("v273EditTag");if(tag)tag.textContent=msg.slice(0,34);
    this.log(msg);
  },
  v273ApplyAdapter(kind){
    this.v273Adapter=kind;
    const line=document.getElementById("v273MegaLine");
    const tag=document.getElementById("v273MegaTag");
    const set=(name,msg)=>{if(tag)tag.textContent=name;if(line)line.innerHTML="<b>"+name+":</b> "+msg;this.smooth(name,msg);};
    if(kind==="defender"){
      this.v273StartCardDuel("defender");
      set("Defender / TCG","25-life Defender card route loaded: deck, hand, mana, summon, attack.");
    }else if(kind==="phone"){
      this.v273PhoneRealmSeed();
      set("Phone-Realms","gesture/layer/screen-as-world seed loaded.");
    }else if(kind==="splitshadow"){
      this.generatePlainBattle("2v2 splitshadow action arena");
      this.arenaMode="SplitShadow";
      this.setControlStyle("SwingArc");
      set("SplitShadow","direct-action pressure route loaded.");
    }else if(kind==="ftr"){
      this.v272aAim("pull");
      this.inputDeviceMode="ARROW";this.control="PLAYER";
      set("FTR Controls","body-route controls active: pull / drag / fire / fling.");
    }else if(kind==="humanimals"){
      this.v273HumanimalsSeed();
      set("Humanimals Seed","beast/body arena seed loaded as future mode lane.");
    }
    this.render();
  },
  v273PhoneRealmSeed(){
    this.projectName="Generated Phone-Realms Gesture Layer";
    this.arenaMode="PhoneRealm";
    this.setControlStyle("DragAim");
    this.generatedScene("Phone-Realms Layer Route",{x:2,y:7},[
      this.obj("Player",2,7,{hp:5,maxHp:5,team:"A",name:"You-Rep"}),
      this.obj("Portal",4,6,{name:"App Gate"}),
      this.obj("Portal",8,4,{name:"Layer Gate"}),
      this.obj("Coin",6,7,{name:"Signal"}),
      this.obj("Enemy",12,5,{hp:3,maxHp:3,damage:1,behaviour:"chase",name:"Glitch"}),
      this.obj("Goal",14,1,{name:"Realm Exit"}),
      this.obj("Wall",5,2),this.obj("Wall",5,3),this.obj("Wall",10,5),this.obj("Wall",10,6)
    ],{
      objects:["You-Rep","App Gate","Layer Gate","Signal","Glitch","Realm Exit"],
      rules:["gesture through layers","collect signal","avoid glitch","reach realm exit"],
      controls:["Drag","Fire","Arrow Mode","Gesture Pad"],
      win:"Reach Realm Exit",

/* v27.3 gesture routing */
const _v273ApplyGesturePad=GP.applyGesturePad.bind(GP);
GP.applyGesturePad=function(){
  const mode=this.v272aAimMode||"pull";
  if(!this.gestureStart||!this.gestureEnd)return _v273ApplyGesturePad();
  const dx=this.gestureEnd.x-this.gestureStart.x,dy=this.gestureEnd.y-this.gestureStart.y;
  const dist=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
  if(dist<10)return _v273ApplyGesturePad();
  if(mode==="pull"){
    this.setControlStyle("FlickLaunch");
    this.v273AimReadout("PULL released · force "+Math.round(dist));
    return _v273ApplyGesturePad();
  }
  if(mode==="drag"){
    this.setControlStyle("DragAim");
    this.v273AimReadout("DRAG released · target set");
    return _v273ApplyGesturePad();
  }
  if(mode==="fire"){
    this.setControlStyle("DragAim");
    this.v273AimReadout("FIRE · direct action");
    this.setAction("Shoot");
    const p=this.getPlayer();
    if(p){const sx=Math.sign(dx),sy=Math.sign(dy);this.cursor={x:Math.max(0,Math.min(this.w-1,p.x+sx*4)),y:Math.max(0,Math.min(this.h-1,p.y+sy*3))};this.target={...this.cursor};}
    this.useAction();
    this.render();
    return;
  }
  if(mode==="fling"){
    this.setControlStyle("FlickLaunch");
    this.v273AimReadout("FLING released · launch route");
    return _v273ApplyGesturePad();
  }
  return _v273ApplyGesturePad();
};

  v276UpdateAimDock(){
    const state=document.getElementById("v276AimState");

    const aim=(this.v272aAimMode||this.controlStyle||"pull").toString();

    const result={
      rebound:"launch route",

      mmo:"party/quest/gate",
      platform:"jump/climb route",

    state.textContent=`${aim.toUpperCase()} · ${name} → ${result}`;

  v276MiniGestureStart(ev){
    ev.preventDefault();
    const r=ev.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    this.v276MiniGestureStartPoint={x:ev.clientX-r.left,y:ev.clientY-r.top};
    this.v276MiniGestureCurrent={...this.v276MiniGestureStartPoint};
    ev.currentTarget.setPointerCapture?.(ev.pointerId);
    this.v276DrawMiniGesture(ev.currentTarget);
  },
  v276MiniGestureMove(ev){
    if(!this.v276MiniGestureStartPoint)return;
    const r=ev.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    this.v276MiniGestureCurrent={x:ev.clientX-r.left,y:ev.clientY-r.top};
    this.v276DrawMiniGesture(ev.currentTarget);
  },
  v276MiniGestureEnd(ev){
    if(!this.v276MiniGestureStartPoint)return;
    const r=ev.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const end={x:ev.clientX-r.left,y:ev.clientY-r.top};
    const start=this.v276MiniGestureStartPoint;
    const dx=end.x-start.x, dy=end.y-start.y;
    const dist=Math.round(Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy));
    const selected=this.selected||this.getPlayer?.();
    const name=selected?.props?.name||selected?.type||"P";
    this.v273AimReadout?.(`${(this.v272aAimMode||"pull").toUpperCase()} from ${name} · force ${dist}`);
    this.smooth("Aim Connected",`${name} → ${this.v275DetectKind?.()||"arena"} · force ${dist}`);
    // Mirror into old gesture system so existing logic still works.
    this.gestureStart={x:start.x,y:start.y};
    this.gestureEnd={x:end.x,y:end.y};
    try{this.applyGesturePad()}catch(e){}
    this.v276MiniGestureStartPoint=null;
    this.v276MiniGestureCurrent=null;
    this.v276DrawMiniGesture(ev.currentTarget,true);
    this.render();
  },
  v276MiniGestureCancel(ev){
    this.v276MiniGestureStartPoint=null;
    this.v276MiniGestureCurrent=null;
    this.v276DrawMiniGesture(ev.currentTarget,true);
  },
  v276DrawMiniGesture(el,clear=false){
    const line=document.getElementById("v276GestureLine");
    if(!line)return;
    if(clear||!this.v276MiniGestureStartPoint||!this.v276MiniGestureCurrent){
      line.style.width="2px"; line.style.opacity="0";
      return;
    }
    const s=this.v276MiniGestureStartPoint, c=this.v276MiniGestureCurrent;
    const dx=c.x-s.x, dy=c.y-s.y;
    const dist=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    const ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx)*180/Math.PI;
    line.style.left=s.x+"px";
    line.style.top=s.y+"px";
    line.style.width=Math.max(2,dist)+"px";
    line.style.transform=`rotate(${ang}deg)`;
    line.style.opacity="1";
  },
  v276ImproveObjectScale(){
    // Keep generated objects visible after render; visual CSS handles most.
  }
});
