    },

    proofImpact(){
      const before={mode:GP.mode,score:GP.score,scene:GP.activeScene,objects:this.contract().objects};
      const after=safe(before);
      after.snapshotHash=this.hash(JSON.stringify(GP.snapshot()));
      after.playableBytes=this.playableHTML().length;
      this.receipt('Proof-only state check',after);
      b1ProofResults.innerHTML=`<div class="b1ProofCheck"><b>DING</b>Current body snapshot ${after.snapshotHash}</div><div class="b1ProofCheck"><b>DING</b>Playable generation ${after.playableBytes} bytes</div>`;
      return {before,after};
    },

    renderReceipts(){
      b1ReceiptLog.textContent=this.receipts.map((r,i)=>
        `${i+1}. ${r.reason}\nHash: ${r.hash}\nPrevious: ${r.previousHash}\nMode: ${r.mode}\nGame: ${r.game}`
      ).join('\n\n');
    },

    refreshAngles(){
      const definitions=[
        {id:'create',label:'CREATE',available:()=>true,run:()=>GP.setMode('GENERATE')},
        {id:'stage',label:'STAGE',available:()=>Boolean(document.getElementById('field')),run:()=>GP.setMode('EDIT')},
        {id:'test',label:'TEST',available:()=>Boolean(document.getElementById('testBtn')),run:()=>GP.setMode('TEST')},
        {id:'package',label:'PACKAGE',available:()=>Boolean(b1PackagePanel),run:()=>GP.setMode('EXPORT')},
        {id:'proof',label:'PROOF',available:()=>Boolean(b1RunProof),run:()=>{GP.setMode('EXPORT');setTimeout(()=>document.querySelector('.b1ProofRoom')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}),50)}}
      ];
      this.angles=definitions.filter(a=>a.available());
      let rail=document.getElementById('b1MatrixAngles');
      if(!rail){
        rail=document.createElement('div');
        rail.id='b1MatrixAngles';
        rail.className='b1MatrixAngles';
        document.querySelector('.tabs')?.after(rail);
      }
      rail.style.setProperty('--b1-angle-count',String(Math.max(1,this.angles.length)));
      rail.replaceChildren(...this.angles.map((a,index)=>{
        const button=document.createElement('button');
        button.textContent=`${index+1}/${this.angles.length} ${a.label}`;
        button.classList.toggle('sel',
          (a.id==='test'&&GP.mode==='TEST') ||
          (a.id==='package'&&GP.mode==='EXPORT') ||
          (a.id==='stage'&&GP.mode==='EDIT') ||
          (a.id==='create'&&(GP.mode==='CREATE'||GP.mode==='GENERATE'))
        );
        button.onclick=a.run;
        return button;
      }));
    }
  };

  window.GPB1=B1;

  const originalSetMode=GP.setMode.bind(GP);
  GP.setMode=function(mode){
    if(mode==='TEST' && !B1.testActive){
      B1.testSourceSnapshot=safe(GP.snapshot());
      B1.testActive=true;
      B1.receipt('Test copy opened',{objects:B1.contract().objects});
    }else if(mode!=='TEST' && B1.testActive && B1.testSourceSnapshot){
      const authored=B1.testSourceSnapshot;
      B1.testSourceSnapshot=null;
      B1.testActive=false;
      GP.applyProject(authored,'Returned from Test to the authored game body.');
      B1.receipt('Authored body restored after Test',{objects:B1.contract().objects});
    }
    const result=originalSetMode(mode);
    if(mode==='EXPORT') B1.showPackage(); else B1.hidePackage();
    const routes={
      CREATE:['Create','Shape the generated game body.'],
      GENERATE:['Generate','Describe the game you want.'],
      EDIT:['Edit','Change the generated body itself.'],
      TEST:['Test','Run the generated game rules.'],
      INSPECT:['Inspect','Read how the current body works.'],
      EXPORT:['Package','Package and prove the current body.']
    };
    if(routes[mode]) B1.setRoute(...routes[mode]);
    B1.update();
    return result;
  };

  const originalGeneratedScene=GP.generatedScene.bind(GP);
  GP.generatedScene=function(...args){
    const result=originalGeneratedScene(...args);
    B1.receipt('Game body generated',{type:GP.generatedGameType,objects:B1.contract().objects});
    B1.setRoute('Body','Generated body connected to Edit, Test and Package.');
    B1.update();
    return result;
  };

  const originalMove=GP.move?.bind(GP);
  if(originalMove){
    GP.move=function(...args){
      const result=originalMove(...args);
      B1.setRoute('Test',`Generated body active · ${GP.runtime?.last||GP.lastActionSummary||'movement'}`);
      return result;
    };
  }

  b1OpenCreator.addEventListener('click',()=>B1.openCreator());
  b1ExportProject.addEventListener('click',()=>B1.exportProject());
  b1ExportPlayable.addEventListener('click',()=>B1.exportPlayable());
  b1ExportManifest.addEventListener('click',()=>B1.exportManifest());
  b1ExportAndroid.addEventListener('click',()=>B1.exportAndroid());
  b1RunProof.addEventListener('click',()=>B1.runProof());
  b1VerifyReceipts.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const ok=B1.verifyReceipts();
    b1ProofResults.innerHTML=`<div class="b1ProofCheck ${ok?'':'fail'}"><b>${ok?'DING':'BUGG'}</b>Receipt chain ${ok?'continuous':'broken'}</div>`;
  });
  b1ProofImpact.addEventListener('click',()=>B1.proofImpact());

  B1.receipt('GlyphPlay B1 genesis');
  B1.update();
  document.documentElement.dataset.glyphplayB1='professional-creator-standing';
})();
</script>


<script id="glyphplay-b1-v29">
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const TYPE_CHOICES = [
    'Player','Goal','Coin','Wall','Enemy','Hazard','Heart','Key','Door','Crate',
    'Flag','Zone','Ball','TeamA','TeamB','Boss','Portal','Treasure','Hero','NPC'
  ];

  const deep = value => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  const clamp = (v,a,b) => Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
  const byId = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const plain = value => {
    const node=document.createElement('div');
    node.innerHTML=String(value||'').replace(/<br\s*\/?\s*>/gi,' · ');
    return (node.textContent||'').replace(/\s*·\s*/g,' · ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
  };

  const V29 = {
    version:'29.0-alpha',
    currentView:'home',
    selected:{x:0,y:0,id:null},
    testSwipe:null,
    patched:false,

    init(){
      document.body.classList.add('b1v29-active');
      this.patchRuntime();
      this.buildNav();
      this.bind();
      this.show('home');
      this.renderAll();
      GPB1.receipt('GlyphPlay B1 v29 creator product opened');
    },

    patchRuntime(){
      if(this.patched) return;
      this.patched=true;
      const names=['render','generatedScene','generateFromIntent','move','useAction','retryCurrent','applyProject','editGenerated','quickChange','placeAtCursor','setMode','renameProject','loadSlot'];
      names.forEach(name=>{
        if(typeof GP[name]!=='function') return;
        const original=GP[name].bind(GP);
        GP[name]=(...args)=>{
          const result=original(...args);
          setTimeout(()=>this.renderAll(),0);
          return result;
        };
      });
    },

    views(){
      return [
        {id:'home',label:'Creator Home'},
        {id:'game',label:'Generated Game'},
        {id:'edit',label:'Exact Edit'},
        {id:'test',label:'Test Copy'},
        {id:'ship',label:'Package + Proof'}
      ];
    },

    buildNav(){
      const nav=byId('b1v29Nav');
      nav.replaceChildren(...this.views().map(view=>{
        const button=document.createElement('button');
        button.textContent=view.label;
        button.dataset.view=view.id;
        button.onclick=()=>this.navigate(view.id);
        return button;
      }));
    },

    navigate(view){
      if(view!=='test' && GPB1.testActive){
        GP.setMode(view==='ship'?'EXPORT':'EDIT');
      }
      if(view==='test') return this.enterTest();
      if(view==='ship') GP.setMode('EXPORT');
      if(view==='edit') GP.setMode('EDIT');
      if(view==='game' && GP.mode==='EXPORT') GP.setMode('EDIT');
      this.show(view);
    },

    show(view){
      this.currentView=view;
      document.querySelectorAll('.b1v29-view').forEach(section=>{
        section.classList.toggle('active',section.dataset.b1v29View===view);
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('#b1v29Nav button').forEach(button=>{
        button.classList.toggle('active',button.dataset.view===view);
      });
      window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
      this.renderAll();
    },

    contract(){
      const parts=GP.generatedParts || {};
      const scene=GP.scene() || {};
      return {
        name:GP.projectName || scene.name || 'Untitled Game',
        game:GP.generatedGameType && GP.generatedGameType!=='None' ? GP.generatedGameType : (scene.name || 'Template Doorway'),
        summary:plain(GP.generatedSummary || 'Generated game body.'),
        controls:(parts.controls || [GP.controlStyle || 'Move']).join(' · '),
        win:parts.win || 'Reach the generated objective',
        fail:parts.fail || 'Generated rules decide',
        objects:Array.isArray(scene.objects)?scene.objects.length:0
      };
    },

    scene(){
      return GP.scene() || {name:'No scene',objects:[]};
    },

    objectAt(x,y){
      const objects=this.scene().objects || [];
      const player=objects.find(o=>o.type==='Player'&&o.x===x&&o.y===y);
      return player || objects.find(o=>o.x===x&&o.y===y) || null;
    },

    typeDef(type){
      return GP.def(type) || GP.typeDefs[type] || {glyph:(type||'?')[0],className:'custom',role:'custom',props:{}};
    },

    glyph(object){
      if(!object) return '';
      return this.typeDef(object.type).glyph || object.type?.[0] || '?';
    },

    cellClass(object){
      if(!object) return '';
      const def=this.typeDef(object.type);
      return [object.type,def.role,def.className].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/g,' ');
    },

    renderGrid(id,editable=false){
      const grid=byId(id);
      if(!grid) return;
      const scene=this.scene();
      const frag=document.createDocumentFragment();
      for(let y=0;y<GP.h;y++){
        for(let x=0;x<GP.w;x++){
          const object=this.objectAt(x,y);
          const cell=document.createElement(editable?'button':'div');
          cell.className='b1v29-cell '+this.cellClass(object);
          if(editable && this.selected.x===x && this.selected.y===y) cell.classList.add('selected');
          cell.dataset.x=x;cell.dataset.y=y;
          cell.innerHTML=`<span>${this.glyph(object)||''}</span>${editable?`<small>${x},${y}</small>`:''}`;
          if(editable) cell.onclick=()=>this.selectCell(x,y,object);
          frag.appendChild(cell);
        }
      }
      grid.replaceChildren(frag);
      grid.setAttribute('aria-label',`${scene.name||'Scene'} · ${scene.objects?.length||0} objects`);
    },

    renderAll(){
      if(typeof GP!=='object' || !GP.scene()) return;
      const c=this.contract();
      byId('b1v29ProjectName').value=GP.projectName;
      byId('b1v29CurrentName').textContent=c.game;
      byId('b1v29CurrentSummary').textContent=c.summary;
      byId('b1v29HomeObjects').textContent=c.objects;
      byId('b1v29HomeControls').textContent=c.controls;
      byId('b1v29HomeWin').textContent=c.win;

      byId('b1v29GameTitle').textContent=c.game;
      byId('b1v29GameSummary').textContent=c.summary;
      byId('b1v29GameWin').textContent=c.win;
      byId('b1v29GameControls').textContent=c.controls;
      byId('b1v29GameObjects').textContent=c.objects;
      byId('b1v29StageScene').textContent=this.scene().name || 'Scene';
      byId('b1v29StageState').textContent=GPB1.testActive?'Test copy active':'Authored body';

      byId('b1v29TestTitle').textContent=c.game;
      byId('b1v29HPHud').textContent=`${GP.playerHP}/${GP.maxHP}`;
      byId('b1v29EnergyHud').textContent=`${GP.energy}/${GP.maxEnergy}`;
      byId('b1v29ScoreHud').textContent=GP.score;
      byId('b1v29StateHud').textContent=GP.state;
      byId('b1v29TestMessage').textContent=GP.runtime?.last || GP.lastActionSummary || 'Move the player and prove the generated loop.';

      byId('b1v29ShipGame').textContent=c.game;
      byId('b1v29ShipControls').textContent=c.controls;
      byId('b1v29ShipWin').textContent=c.win;
      byId('b1v29ShipObjects').textContent=c.objects;

      this.renderGrid('b1v29GameGrid');
      this.renderGrid('b1v29EditGrid',true);
      this.renderGrid('b1v29TestGrid');
      this.renderInspector();
      this.renderReceipts();
    },

    create(prompt){
      const text=(prompt||byId('b1v29Prompt').value).trim();
      if(!text){
        byId('b1v29Prompt').focus();
        return;
      }
      byId('intentInput').value=text;
      GP.generateIntent(text);
      byId('b1v29Prompt').value=text;
      this.show('game');
      GPB1.receipt('v29 game created',{prompt:text,objects:this.contract().objects});
    },

    applyWords(inputId){
      const input=byId(inputId);
      const command=(input.value||'').trim();
      if(!command) return;
      if(GPB1.testActive) GP.setMode('EDIT');
      let changed=false;
      if(typeof GP.editGenerated==='function') changed=GP.editGenerated(command)===true;
      if(!changed && typeof GP.commandText==='function') GP.commandText(command);
      input.value='';
      byId('b1v29ChangeTray').classList.add('hidden');
      GPB1.receipt('v29 word change applied',{command});
      this.show('game');
    },

    selectCell(x,y,object){
      this.selected={x,y,id:object?.id||null};
      byId('b1v29EditSelection').textContent=object?`${object.type} at ${x},${y}`:`Empty cell ${x},${y}`;
      this.renderAll();
    },

    selectedObject(){
      return this.selected.id ? this.scene().objects.find(o=>o.id===this.selected.id) || null : null;
    },

    renderInspector(){
      const object=this.selectedObject();
      const x=object?.x ?? this.selected.x;
      const y=object?.y ?? this.selected.y;
      const type=object?.type || 'Coin';
      const def=this.typeDef(type);
      const props=object?.props || {};
      const select=byId('b1v29Type');
      const types=[...new Set([...TYPE_CHOICES,...Object.keys(GP.typeDefs||{}),type])];
      select.innerHTML=types.map(t=>`<option value="${t}">${t}</option>`).join('');
      select.value=type;
      byId('b1v29InspectorTitle').textContent=object?`${type} · ${x},${y}`:`Place an object at ${x},${y}`;
      byId('b1v29Glyph').value=def.glyph || '';
      byId('b1v29X').value=x;
      byId('b1v29Y').value=y;
      byId('b1v29HP').value=props.hp ?? props.maxHp ?? 0;
      byId('b1v29Value').value=props.scoreValue ?? props.damage ?? props.value ?? 0;
      byId('b1v29Solid').checked=!!props.solid;
      byId('b1v29Collectible').checked=!!props.collectible;
      byId('b1v29Danger').checked=!!props.danger;
      byId('b1v29Controllable').checked=!!props.controllable;
    },

    applyObject(){
      const scene=this.scene();
      const existing=this.selectedObject();
      const type=byId('b1v29Type').value;
      const x=clamp(Number(byId('b1v29X').value)||0,0,GP.w-1);
      const y=clamp(Number(byId('b1v29Y').value)||0,0,GP.h-1);
      const hp=Math.max(0,Number(byId('b1v29HP').value)||0);
      const value=Number(byId('b1v29Value').value)||0;
      const def=this.typeDef(type);

      if(type==='Player'){
        scene.objects=scene.objects.filter(o=>o.type!=='Player'||o.id===existing?.id);
      }

      const object=existing || GP.obj(type,x,y);
      object.type=type;object.x=x;object.y=y;
      object.props={...(def.props||{}),...(object.props||{})};
      object.props.solid=byId('b1v29Solid').checked;
      object.props.collectible=byId('b1v29Collectible').checked;
      object.props.danger=byId('b1v29Danger').checked;
      object.props.controllable=byId('b1v29Controllable').checked;
      if(hp>0){object.props.hp=hp;object.props.maxHp=Math.max(hp,object.props.maxHp||hp)}
      if(type==='Coin'||object.props.collectible) object.props.scoreValue=value||1;
      if(type==='Enemy'||type==='Hazard'||object.props.danger) object.props.damage=value||1;
      object.props.value=value;

      if(!existing) scene.objects.push(object);
      if(!GP.typeDefs[type]) GP.typeDefs[type]={...def,props:{...(def.props||{})}};
      GP.typeDefs[type].glyph=byId('b1v29Glyph').value || def.glyph || type[0];

      this.selected={x,y,id:object.id};
      GP.render();
      GPB1.receipt('v29 exact object applied',{type,x,y});
      this.renderAll();
    },

    deleteObject(){
      const object=this.selectedObject();
      if(!object) return;
      if(object.type==='Player'){
        byId('b1v29InspectorTitle').textContent='The only Player cannot be deleted. Move or replace it.';
        return;
      }
      this.scene().objects=this.scene().objects.filter(o=>o.id!==object.id);
      GPB1.receipt('v29 object deleted',{type:object.type,x:object.x,y:object.y});
      this.selected={x:object.x,y:object.y,id:null};
      GP.render();
      this.renderAll();
    },

    enterTest(){
      if(!GPB1.testActive) GP.setMode('TEST');
      this.show('test');
      GPB1.receipt('v29 test copy entered',{objects:this.contract().objects});
    },

    exitTest(){
      if(GPB1.testActive) GP.setMode('EDIT');
      this.show('game');
      GPB1.receipt('v29 test copy exited and authored body restored',{objects:this.contract().objects});
    },

    move(dx,dy){
      GP.move(dx,dy);
      this.renderAll();
    },

    action(){
      GP.useAction();
      this.renderAll();
    },

    restartTest(){
      GP.retryCurrent();
      this.renderAll();
    },

    export(kind){
      const routes={
        project:()=>GPB1.exportProject(),
        playable:()=>GPB1.exportPlayable(),
        manifest:()=>GPB1.exportManifest(),
        android:()=>GPB1.exportAndroid()
      };
      routes[kind]?.();
      byId('b1v29ShipStatus').textContent=`${kind} output generated from ${this.contract().objects} authored objects.`;
      this.renderReceipts();
    },

    runProof(){
      const result=GPB1.runProof();
      byId('b1v29ProofResults').innerHTML=result.checks.map(([name,ok])=>
        `<div class="b1v29-proof-check ${ok?'':'fail'}"><b>${ok?'DING':'BUGG'}</b>${name}</div>`
      ).join('');
      byId('b1v29ShipStatus').textContent=result.pass?'Professional standing proof passed.':'Proof found a gap.';
      this.renderReceipts();
      return result;
    },

    verifyReceipts(){
      const ok=GPB1.verifyReceipts();
      byId('b1v29ProofResults').innerHTML=`<div class="b1v29-proof-check ${ok?'':'fail'}"><b>${ok?'DING':'BUGG'}</b>Receipt chain ${ok?'continuous':'broken'}</div>`;
      return ok;
    },

    renderReceipts(){
      if(!window.GPB1) return;
      byId('b1v29Receipts').textContent=GPB1.receipts.slice(0,30).map((r,i)=>
        `${i+1}. ${r.reason}\n${r.hash} ← ${r.previousHash}`
      ).join('\n\n');
    },

    openDeep(){
      document.body.classList.add('b1v29-deep');
      if(GPB1.testActive) GP.setMode('EDIT');
      GP.setMode('EDIT');
    },

    closeDeep(){
      document.body.classList.remove('b1v29-deep');
      this.renderAll();
    },

    bind(){
      byId('b1v29Create').onclick=()=>this.create();
      byId('b1v29Continue').onclick=()=>this.show('game');
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-b1v29-prompt]').forEach(button=>{
        button.onclick=()=>{
          const prompt=button.dataset.b1v29Prompt;
          byId('b1v29Prompt').value=prompt;
          this.create(prompt);
        };
      });
      byId('b1v29Play').onclick=()=>this.enterTest();
      byId('b1v29Edit').onclick=()=>this.navigate('edit');
      byId('b1v29Change').onclick=()=>byId('b1v29ChangeTray').classList.toggle('hidden');
      byId('b1v29ApplyWords').onclick=()=>this.applyWords('b1v29ChangeInput');
      byId('b1v29CancelWords').onclick=()=>byId('b1v29ChangeTray').classList.add('hidden');
      byId('b1v29ApplyObject').onclick=()=>this.applyObject();
      byId('b1v29DeleteObject').onclick=()=>this.deleteObject();
      byId('b1v29BackGame').onclick=()=>this.show('game');
      byId('b1v29EditWordsApply').onclick=()=>this.applyWords('b1v29EditWords');
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-b1v29-move]').forEach(button=>{
        button.onclick=()=>{
          const [dx,dy]=button.dataset.b1v29Move.split(',').map(Number);
          this.move(dx,dy);
        };
      });
      byId('b1v29Action').onclick=()=>this.action();
      byId('b1v29RestartTest').onclick=()=>this.restartTest();
      byId('b1v29ExitTest').onclick=()=>this.exitTest();
      byId('b1v29ExportProject').onclick=()=>this.export('project');
      byId('b1v29ExportPlayable').onclick=()=>this.export('playable');
      byId('b1v29ExportManifest').onclick=()=>this.export('manifest');
      byId('b1v29ExportAndroid').onclick=()=>this.export('android');
      byId('b1v29RunProof').onclick=()=>this.runProof();
      byId('b1v29VerifyReceipts').onclick=()=>this.verifyReceipts();
      byId('b1v29OpenDeep').onclick=()=>this.openDeep();
      byId('b1v29Return').onclick=()=>this.closeDeep();

      byId('b1v29ProjectName').addEventListener('change',event=>GP.renameProject(event.target.value));
      byId('b1v29Save').onclick=()=>{GP.saveSlot();this.renderAll()};
      byId('b1v29Load').onclick=()=>{GP.loadSlot();setTimeout(()=>this.renderAll(),20)};

      const grid=byId('b1v29TestGrid');
      grid.addEventListener('pointerdown',event=>{
        this.testSwipe={x:event.clientX,y:event.clientY};
      });
      grid.addEventListener('pointerup',event=>{
        if(!this.testSwipe) return;
        const dx=event.clientX-this.testSwipe.x;
        const dy=event.clientY-this.testSwipe.y;
        this.testSwipe=null;
        if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<24) return;
        const sx=Math.abs(dx)>18?Math.sign(dx):0;
        const sy=Math.abs(dy)>18?Math.sign(dy):0;
        this.move(sx,sy);
      });

      addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
        if(this.currentView!=='test') return;
        const move={ArrowUp:[0,-1],ArrowDown:[0,1],ArrowLeft:[-1,0],ArrowRight:[1,0]}[event.key];
        if(move){event.preventDefault();this.move(...move)}
      });
    }
  };

  window.GPB1V29=V29;
  addEventListener('load',()=>setTimeout(()=>V29.init(),40));
})();
</script>


<script id="glyphplay-b1-v291-density">
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const V291 = {
    version:'29.1-alpha',
    hasBody(){
      return Boolean(
        GP.generatedGameType && GP.generatedGameType !== 'None' &&
        GP.scene() && Array.isArray(GP.scene().objects) && GP.scene().objects.length > 0
      );
    },
    displayName(){
      return this.hasBody() ? (GP.projectName || GP.generatedGameType) : 'New Game';
    },
    sync(){
      const has=this.hasBody();
      b1v29ProjectName.value=this.displayName();
      b1v29ProjectName.placeholder='New Game';
      b1v29Continue.classList.toggle('b1v29ContinueUnavailable',!has);
      b1v29Continue.disabled=!has;
      b1v29Continue.setAttribute('aria-hidden',String(!has));
      const current=document.querySelector('.b1v29-current');

function compare(a,op,b){return op==='>'?a>b:op==='>='?a>=b:op==='<'?a<b:op==='<='?a<=b:a==b}

  pushHistory('add JMLogic');const r={id:'route-'+Date.now(),when:$('jmWhen').value,metric:$('jmMetric').value,compare:$('jmCompare').value,threshold:+$('jmThreshold').value||0,change:$('jmChange').value,amount:$('jmAmount').value,then:$('jmThen').value};

  $('jmLogicList').innerHTML=state.jmLogic.length?state.jmLogic.map(r=>`<div class="logicRoute"><code>WHEN ${r.when} → IF ${r.metric} ${r.compare} ${r.threshold} → CHANGE ${r.change} TO ${r.amount} → THEN ${r.then}</code><button data-remove-route="${r.id}">Remove</button></div>`).join(''):'<div class="muted">No custom route yet. The boxes above compile into the live runtime.</div>';
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-remove-route]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>removeJMLogic(b.dataset.removeRoute))

function runJMLogic(event,ctx){
  state.jmLogic.filter(r=>r.when===event).forEach(r=>{
    const metric=r.metric==='speed'?ctx.speed||0:r.metric==='hits'?state.arcade.hits:r.metric==='score'?state.arcade.score:state.arcade.coreHp;
    if(!compare(metric,r.compare,r.threshold))return;
    const amount=Number(r.amount);
    if(r.change==='score-add')state.arcade.score+=(Number.isFinite(amount)?amount:0);
    if(r.change==='core-health-subtract')state.arcade.coreHp=Math.max(0,state.arcade.coreHp-(Number.isFinite(amount)?amount:0));
    if(r.change==='core-health-set')state.arcade.coreHp=Math.max(0,Number.isFinite(amount)?amount:state.arcade.coreHp);
    if(r.change==='state-set')state.status=String(r.amount);
    if(r.then==='feedback'||r.then==='both')showFeedback('JMLOGIC');
    if(r.then==='receipt'||r.then==='both')receipt('JMLogic consequence: '+r.id);
    log('jmlogic_fired',{id:r.id,event,metric,value:metric})
  })
}

function compileRulesPhrase(text){
  const s=text.toLowerCase(),rules={};
  ['double-score','diagonal-burst','receipt-on-hit','wall-bonus','glass-core'].forEach(k=>{if(new RegExp('(?:^|\\s)'+k+'(?:\\s|$)').test(s))rules[k]=true});
  const number=k=>{const m=s.match(new RegExp(k.replace('-','[- ]')+'\\s+(-?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)'));if(m)rules[k]=clamp(+m[1],RuleRegistry[k].min,RuleRegistry[k].max)};
  ['core-health','hit-multiplier','bounce','force-multiplier','goal-score','max-pull','deadzone'].forEach(number);
  return rules
}

  pushHistory('compile live rules');state.activeRules=compileRulesPhrase($('rules').value);
  if(state.activeRules['max-pull'])$('maxPull').value=state.activeRules['max-pull'];

}

  const nx=clamp(state.player.x+dx,0,N-1),ny=clamp(state.player.y+dy,0,N-1),dest=state.cells[key(nx,ny)];
  if(dest==='wall'){state.status='blocked';runJMLogic('wall-contact',{speed:1});log('blocked',{x:nx,y:ny});renderField();return}
  pushHistory('grid move');const old=key(state.player.x,state.player.y),oldMeta=state.objectMeta[old]||defaultMeta('player',state.player.x,state.player.y);delete state.cells[old];delete state.objectMeta[old];
  if(dest==='coin'){state.score+=state.activeRules['double-score']?2:1;state.status='gem collected';runJMLogic('collect',{speed:1})}
  else if(dest==='goal'){state.score+=state.activeRules['goal-score']||10;state.status='goal reached';runJMLogic('goal-contact',{speed:1});receipt('Goal reached')}
  else if(dest==='enemy'){state.status='enemy contact';runJMLogic('enemy-contact',{speed:1});receipt('Enemy contact')}
  else state.status='moved';
  if(dx&&dy&&state.activeRules['diagonal-burst'])state.score+=1;
  state.player={x:nx,y:ny};state.cells[key(nx,ny)]='player';state.objectMeta[key(nx,ny)]={...oldMeta,x:nx,y:ny,id:'player-'+nx+'-'+ny};state.selected={x:nx,y:ny};
  log('grid_move',{dx,dy,to:state.player});pulseSync('GF','Grid movement loop');renderAll()
}

<script id="glyphforge-matrix-screenfit-v681a">
(() => {
  const GFMatrix = {
    angle: 'arena',
    angles: [],
    routeText: {
      arena: () => `Arena · ${testBodyName.textContent} · Pull back and release`,
      loops: () => `Loops · ${GlyphForge68.state.mode} · choose one force route`,
      tune: () => `Tune · force ${force.value} · pull ${maxPull.value} · deadzone ${deadzone.value}`,
      body: () => `Body · ${activeTboy.textContent} · active test carrier`,
      trace: () => `Trace · ${GlyphForge68.state.events.length} events · ${GlyphForge68.state.receipts.length} receipts`
    },
    discover() {
      const seen = new Set();
      this.angles = [...document.querySelectorAll('.playLayerBody[data-play-layer-body]')]
        .map(el => el.dataset.playLayerBody)
        .filter(name => name && !seen.has(name) && seen.add(name));

      const host = document.getElementById('mobilePlayLayers');
      if (!host) return;
      host.style.setProperty('--angle-count', String(Math.max(1, this.angles.length)));
      host.replaceChildren(...this.angles.map((name, index) => {
        const button = document.createElement('button');
        button.className = 'playLayerButton' + (name === this.angle ? ' active' : '');
        button.dataset.playLayer = name;
        button.innerHTML = `<b>${index + 1}/${this.angles.length}</b><span>${name.toUpperCase()}</span>`;
        button.addEventListener('click', event => {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.setAngle(name);
        });
        return button;
      }));
    },
    setAngle(angle) {
      if (!this.angles.includes(angle)) this.discover();
      this.angle = this.angles.includes(angle) ? angle : (this.angles[0] || 'arena');
      document.querySelectorAll('.playLayerButton').forEach(button => {
        button.classList.toggle('active', button.dataset.playLayer === this.angle);
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.playLayerBody').forEach(body => {
        body.classList.toggle('mobileLayerActive', body.dataset.playLayerBody === this.angle);
      });
      this.sync();
      if (matchMedia('(max-width:560px)').matches) {
        const play = document.querySelector('#play');
        if (play) {
          const top = play.getBoundingClientRect().top + scrollY;
          scrollTo({ top, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      }
    },
    sync() {
      const display = document.getElementById('mobileRouteValue');
      if (!display) return;
      const total = Math.max(1, this.angles.length);
      const position = Math.max(1, this.angles.indexOf(this.angle) + 1);
      display.textContent = `Angle ${position} of ${total} · ${this.routeText[this.angle]?.() || this.angle}`;
    }
  };

  window.GFMatrix = GFMatrix;
  window.GF128 = GFMatrix; // compatibility alias: 128 is a scalable field placeholder, not a fixed count.

  ['maxPull', 'force', 'deadzone'].forEach(id => {
    document.getElementById(id)?.addEventListener('input', () => GFMatrix.sync());
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.mode').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => setTimeout(() => GFMatrix.sync(), 0)));
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-template]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => setTimeout(() => GFMatrix.sync(), 0)));
  document.querySelector('[data-action="cycleTboy"]')?.addEventListener('click', () => setTimeout(() => GFMatrix.sync(), 0));

  const observer = new MutationObserver(() => GFMatrix.sync());
  ['testBodyName', 'activeTboy', 'eventCount', 'receiptCount'].forEach(id => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) observer.observe(el, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
  });

  GFMatrix.discover();
  GFMatrix.setAngle(GFMatrix.angles[0] || 'arena');
  document.documentElement.dataset.glyphforgeScreenfit = 'matrix-angle-placeholder';
})();
</script>

  if (!oldCanvas) return;

  // Replace the visible canvas so the inherited generic test listeners cannot
  // compete with the connected ProjectBody scene.
  const canvas = oldCanvas.cloneNode(false);
  oldCanvas.replaceWith(canvas);
  canvas.width = 980;
  canvas.height = 620;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const BOUNDS = {left:58, top:68, right:922, bottom:562};
  const COLS = 9;
  const ROWS = 9;
  const cellW = (BOUNDS.right - BOUNDS.left) / COLS;
  const cellH = (BOUNDS.bottom - BOUNDS.top) / ROWS;
  const clamp = (v,a,b) => Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
  const state = GlyphForge68.state;

  const bridge = {
    mounted:false,
    live:false,
    scene:null,
    drag:null,
    player:null,
    raf:0,
    lastFrame:0,
    collisionClock:new Map(),
    events:[],
    version:'68.2-alpha',

    cellCenter(x,y){
      return {
        x:BOUNDS.left + (x + .5) * cellW,
        y:BOUNDS.top + (y + .5) * cellH
      };
    },

    radiusFor(type){
      return ({player:22, coin:13, wall:24, goal:27, enemy:22, target:31})[type] || 18;
    },

    mount(reason='manual'){
      const body = GlyphForge68.projectBody();
      const objects = body.scenes?.[0]?.objects || [];
      const playerSource = objects.find(o => o.type === 'player') || {
        id:'fallback-player', name:'Player', type:'player', x:1, y:1,
        glyph:state.assets.player?.glyph || '◆',
        color:state.assets.player?.color || '#5be9ff',
        health:100, value:0, components:{movable:true}
      };

      this.scene = {
        schema:body.schema,
        bodyName:body.name,
        sourceHash:this.hash(JSON.stringify(body.scenes[0])),
        objects:objects.map(source => {
          const p=this.cellCenter(source.x,source.y);
          return {
            ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(source)),
            wx:p.x, wy:p.y,
            radius:this.radiusFor(source.type),
            collected:false,
            defeated:false,
            touched:false,
            runtimeHealth:Number(source.health)||(
              source.type==='target' ? Number(state.activeRules['core-health']||160) :
              source.type==='enemy' ? 100 : 0
            )
          };
        })
      };

      const mountedPlayer = this.scene.objects.find(o => o.type === 'player') || playerSource;
      const pp = this.cellCenter(mountedPlayer.x,mountedPlayer.y);
      this.player = {
        id:mountedPlayer.id,
        name:mountedPlayer.name || 'Player',
        glyph:mountedPlayer.glyph || state.assets.player?.glyph || '◆',
        color:mountedPlayer.color || state.assets.player?.color || '#5be9ff',
        x:pp.x,y:pp.y,vx:0,vy:0,r:22
      };

      const target = this.target();
      state.arcade = {
        coreHp: target ? target.runtimeHealth : Number(state.activeRules['core-health']||160),
        hits:0,
        score:0
      };

      this.mounted=true;
      this.live=false;
      this.drag=null;
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf);
      this.events.unshift({
        time:new Date().toISOString(),
        type:'projectbody_mounted',
        reason,
        objects:this.scene.objects.length,
        hash:this.scene.sourceHash
      });

      this.setConnection('CONNECTED', `${this.scene.objects.length}`, `${this.scene.bodyName} · ${this.scene.sourceHash}`);
      testBodyName.textContent=this.scene.bodyName;
      playStatus.textContent='BODY CONNECTED · press Start Play Test';
      aimHint.textContent=`${this.scene.objects.length} forged objects are mounted. Start the test, touch ${this.player.name}, pull backwards and release.`;
      this.draw();
      this.writeRuntimeEvent('body_connected',{
        reason,
        body:this.scene.bodyName,
        objects:this.scene.objects.length,
        hash:this.scene.sourceHash
      });
      this.receipt(`Body connected: ${this.scene.bodyName} · ${this.scene.objects.length} objects`);
      if (window.GFMatrix) {
        GFMatrix.discover();
        GFMatrix.setAngle('arena');
      }
      return this.scene;
    },

    start(){
      this.mount('play-test-start');
      this.live=true;
      playGate.classList.add('hidden');
      playResult.classList.add('hidden');
      playStatus.textContent='LIVE · connected field running';
      aimHint.textContent=`Touch ${this.player.name}, pull backwards and release. Gems collect; walls rebound; enemies and the target take impact.`;
      this.events.unshift({time:new Date().toISOString(),type:'connected_test_started'});
      this.writeRuntimeEvent('connected_play_test_started',{
        body:this.scene.bodyName,
        objects:this.scene.objects.length
      });
      this.draw();
    },

    reset(){
      this.mount('connected-reset');
      this.live=true;
      playGate.classList.add('hidden');
      playResult.classList.add('hidden');
      playStatus.textContent='LIVE · connected field reset';
      this.draw();
    },

    target(){
      if (!this.scene) return null;
      return this.scene.objects.find(o => o.type==='target' && !o.defeated)
        || this.scene.objects.find(o => o.type==='goal' && !o.defeated)
        || null;
    },

    setConnection(label,count,route){
      bodyBridgeStatus.classList.remove('connected','connecting');
      if(label==='CONNECTED') bodyBridgeStatus.classList.add('connected');
      if(label==='CONNECTING') bodyBridgeStatus.classList.add('connecting');
      bodyBridgeState.textContent=label;
      bodyBridgeCount.textContent=count;
      bodyBridgeRoute.textContent=route;
    },

    hash(text){
      let h=2166136261;
      for(let i=0;i<text.length;i++){
        h^=text.charCodeAt(i);
        h+=(h<<1)+(h<<4)+(h<<7)+(h<<8)+(h<<24);
      }
      return ('00000000'+(h>>>0).toString(16)).slice(-8);
    },

    writeRuntimeEvent(type,body){
      state.events.unshift({time:new Date().toISOString(),type,body});
      if(state.events.length>180) state.events.pop();
      if(window.eventCount) eventCount.textContent=state.events.length;
      if(window.events) events.textContent=state.events.map((e,i)=>
        `${i+1}. ${e.type} — ${JSON.stringify(e.body)}`
      ).join('\n');
    },

    receipt(reason){
      // Use the existing engine route so this bridge remains in the same estate
      // receipt chain rather than maintaining a second proof system.
      try { GF_do('saveReceipt'); } catch(_) {}
      this.events.unshift({time:new Date().toISOString(),type:'bridge_receipt',reason});
    },

    position(event){
      const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      return {
        x:(event.clientX-r.left)*canvas.width/r.width,
        y:(event.clientY-r.top)*canvas.height/r.height
      };
    },

    begin(event){
      if(!this.mounted) this.mount('first-contact');
      if(!this.live){
        playStatus.textContent='START THE CONNECTED TEST FIRST';
        aimHint.textContent='The body is connected. Press Start Play Test before launching it.';
        return;
      }
      const p=this.position(event);
      const d=Math.hypot(p.x-this.player.x,p.y-this.player.y);
      if(d>this.player.r+48){
        playStatus.textContent='TOUCH THE CONNECTED PLAYER';
        aimHint.textContent=`Touch ${this.player.name} first, then pull backwards.`;
        return;
      }
      this.drag=p;
      this.player.vx*=.12;
      this.player.vy*=.12;
      try{canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId)}catch(_){}
      playStatus.textContent='AIMING · release to run the loop';
      this.draw();
    },

    move(event){
      if(!this.drag) return;
      this.drag=this.position(event);
      const tuning=this.tuning();
      const power=Math.min(100,Math.round(
        Math.min(Math.hypot(this.player.x-this.drag.x,this.player.y-this.drag.y),tuning.maxPull)
        / tuning.maxPull * 100
      ));
      shotPower.textContent=power+'%';
      powerView.value=power;
      this.draw();
    },

    release(event){
      if(!this.drag) return;
      const p=this.drag || this.position(event);
      const tuning=this.tuning();
      let dx=this.player.x-p.x,dy=this.player.y-p.y;
      const length=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
      this.drag=null;
      shotPower.textContent='0%';
      powerView.value=0;
      if(length<tuning.deadzone){
        playStatus.textContent='PULL FURTHER BEFORE RELEASE';
        this.draw();
        return;
      }

      const cap=Math.min(length,tuning.maxPull);
      const modeMult={Pull:1,Pitch:1.12,Fire:1.28,Fling:1.48}[state.mode]||1;
      const ruleMult=Number(state.activeRules['force-multiplier']||1);
      const force=tuning.force/100*modeMult*ruleMult;
      dx=dx/length*cap;
      dy=dy/length*cap;
      this.player.vx=dx*force;
      this.player.vy=dy*force;
      if(state.mode==='Pitch') this.player.vy-=3;

      lastShot.textContent=`${Math.round(cap/tuning.maxPull*100)}% ${state.mode} · CONNECTED`;
      playStatus.textContent='LIVE · connected route moving';
      this.events.unshift({
        time:new Date().toISOString(),
        type:'connected_gesture_release',
        mode:state.mode,
        power:Math.round(cap/tuning.maxPull*100)
      });
      this.writeRuntimeEvent('connected_gesture_release',{
        mode:state.mode,
        power:Math.round(cap/tuning.maxPull*100),
        body:this.scene.bodyName
      });
      this.animate();
    },

    tuning(){
      return {
        maxPull:Number(maxPull.value)||300,
        force:Number(force.value)||15,
        deadzone:Number(deadzone.value)||12
      };
    },

    animate(){
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf);
      const tick=()=>{
        this.player.x+=this.player.vx;
        this.player.y+=this.player.vy;
        this.player.vx*=.986;
        this.player.vy*=.986;

        const bounce=Number(state.activeRules.bounce||.86);
        let boundary=false;
        if(this.player.x<BOUNDS.left+this.player.r || this.player.x>BOUNDS.right-this.player.r){
          this.player.vx*=-bounce;boundary=true;
        }
        if(this.player.y<BOUNDS.top+this.player.r || this.player.y>BOUNDS.bottom-this.player.r){
          this.player.vy*=-bounce;boundary=true;
        }
        this.player.x=clamp(this.player.x,BOUNDS.left+this.player.r,BOUNDS.right-this.player.r);
        this.player.y=clamp(this.player.y,BOUNDS.top+this.player.r,BOUNDS.bottom-this.player.r);
        if(boundary && state.activeRules['wall-bonus']) state.arcade.score+=1;

        this.collide();
        this.draw();

        if(Math.hypot(this.player.vx,this.player.vy)>.12 && this.live){
          this.raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        }else if(this.live){
          playStatus.textContent='LIVE · connected field ready';
        }
      };
      tick();
    },

    cooldown(object,ms=220){
      const now=performance.now();
      const last=this.collisionClock.get(object.id)||0;
      if(now-last<ms) return false;
      this.collisionClock.set(object.id,now);
      return true;
    },

    collide(){
      const speed=Math.hypot(this.player.vx,this.player.vy);
      for(const object of this.scene.objects){
        if(object.type==='player'||object.collected||object.defeated) continue;

        if(object.type==='wall'){
          const halfW=cellW*.34,halfH=cellH*.34;
          const cx=clamp(this.player.x,object.wx-halfW,object.wx+halfW);
          const cy=clamp(this.player.y,object.wy-halfH,object.wy+halfH);
          const dx=this.player.x-cx,dy=this.player.y-cy;
          const dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
          if(dist<this.player.r && this.cooldown(object,120)){
            const nx=dist?dx/dist:(Math.abs(this.player.vx)>Math.abs(this.player.vy)?-Math.sign(this.player.vx):0);
            const ny=dist?dy/dist:(nx?0:-Math.sign(this.player.vy));
            const dot=this.player.vx*nx+this.player.vy*ny;
            this.player.vx=(this.player.vx-2*dot*nx)*(state.activeRules.bounce||.86);
            this.player.vy=(this.player.vy-2*dot*ny)*(state.activeRules.bounce||.86);
            state.arcade.score+=state.activeRules['wall-bonus']?1:0;
            this.writeRuntimeEvent('connected_wall_contact',{id:object.id,x:object.x,y:object.y});
          }
          continue;
        }

        const distance=Math.hypot(this.player.x-object.wx,this.player.y-object.wy);
        if(distance>this.player.r+object.radius || !this.cooldown(object)) continue;

        if(object.type==='coin'){
          object.collected=true;
          const value=Number(object.value)||1;
          const points=value*(state.activeRules['double-score']?2:1);
          state.arcade.score+=points;
          playStatus.textContent=`GEM CONNECTED · +${points}`;
          this.writeRuntimeEvent('connected_collect',{id:object.id,value:points});
          continue;
        }

        if(object.type==='goal'){
          const points=Number(state.activeRules['goal-score']||object.value||10);
          state.arcade.score+=points;
          object.touched=true;
          playStatus.textContent=`GOAL CONNECTED · +${points}`;
          this.writeRuntimeEvent('connected_goal_contact',{id:object.id,value:points});
          this.receipt(`Connected goal reached: ${object.name||object.id}`);
        }

        if(object.type==='enemy'){
          const damage=Math.max(3,Math.round(speed*4*(state.activeRules['hit-multiplier']||1)));
          object.runtimeHealth=Math.max(0,object.runtimeHealth-damage);
          state.arcade.score+=damage;
          if(object.runtimeHealth<=0){
            object.defeated=true;
            playStatus.textContent=`ENEMY DEFEATED · ${object.name||object.id}`;
          }else{
            playStatus.textContent=`ENEMY HIT · ${object.runtimeHealth} HP`;
          }
          this.writeRuntimeEvent('connected_enemy_contact',{
            id:object.id,damage,remaining:object.runtimeHealth
          });
        }

        if(object.type==='target'){
          const damage=Math.max(4,Math.round(speed*5*(state.activeRules['hit-multiplier']||1)));
          object.runtimeHealth=Math.max(0,object.runtimeHealth-damage);
          state.arcade.coreHp=object.runtimeHealth;
          state.arcade.hits+=1;
          state.arcade.score+=damage*(state.activeRules['double-score']?2:1);
          playStatus.textContent=object.runtimeHealth<=0?'TARGET BROKEN · CONNECTED TEST PASSED':`TARGET HIT · ${object.runtimeHealth} HP`;
          this.writeRuntimeEvent('connected_target_contact',{
            id:object.id,damage,remaining:object.runtimeHealth
          });
          if(state.activeRules['receipt-on-hit']) this.receipt(`Connected target contact: ${damage}`);
          if(object.runtimeHealth<=0){
            object.defeated=true;
            this.live=false;
            playResult.classList.remove('hidden');
            playResult.querySelector('h3').textContent='CONNECTED BODY PASSED';
            playResult.querySelector('p').textContent=`${this.scene.bodyName} ran with ${this.scene.objects.length} mounted objects.`;
            this.receipt(`Connected Play Test passed: ${this.scene.bodyName}`);
          }
        }

        const angle=Math.atan2(this.player.y-object.wy,this.player.x-object.wx);
        const rebound=Math.max(5,speed*.75);
        this.player.vx=Math.cos(angle)*rebound;
        this.player.vy=Math.sin(angle)*rebound;
      }
    },

    draw(){
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      const gradient=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      gradient.addColorStop(0,'#08162c');
      gradient.addColorStop(.52,'#07101f');
      gradient.addColorStop(1,'#180b14');
      ctx.fillStyle=gradient;
      ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

      ctx.strokeStyle='#40518c';
      ctx.lineWidth=14;
      ctx.strokeRect(45,55,890,520);
      ctx.strokeStyle='#ffd05e';
      ctx.lineWidth=3;
      ctx.strokeRect(BOUNDS.left,BOUNDS.top,BOUNDS.right-BOUNDS.left,BOUNDS.bottom-BOUNDS.top);

      ctx.lineWidth=1;
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(91,233,255,.15)';
      for(let x=0;x<=COLS;x++){
        const px=BOUNDS.left+x*cellW;
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px,BOUNDS.top);ctx.lineTo(px,BOUNDS.bottom);ctx.stroke();
      }
      for(let y=0;y<=ROWS;y++){
        const py=BOUNDS.top+y*cellH;
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(BOUNDS.left,py);ctx.lineTo(BOUNDS.right,py);ctx.stroke();
      }

      if(this.scene){
        for(const object of this.scene.objects){
          if(object.type==='player'||object.collected||object.defeated) continue;
          this.drawObject(object);
        }
      }

      if(this.drag) this.drawAim();

      if(this.player){
        ctx.fillStyle=this.player.color;
        ctx.strokeStyle='#ecfbff';
        ctx.lineWidth=3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.player.x,this.player.y,this.player.r,0,Math.PI*2);
        ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle='#041018';
        ctx.font='900 16px system-ui';
        ctx.textAlign='center';
        ctx.textBaseline='middle';
        ctx.fillText(this.player.glyph||'◆',this.player.x,this.player.y+1);

        if(this.live&&!this.drag&&Math.hypot(this.player.vx,this.player.vy)<.12){
          ctx.strokeStyle='#5be9ff';
          ctx.lineWidth=3;
          ctx.setLineDash([8,7]);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(this.player.x,this.player.y,this.player.r+13,0,Math.PI*2);
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.setLineDash([]);
        }
      }

      coreHp.textContent=Math.round(state.arcade.coreHp||0);
      hits.textContent=state.arcade.hits||0;
      arcadeScore.textContent=state.arcade.score||0;
      modeName.textContent=state.mode;
    },

    drawObject(object){
      const color=object.color||state.assets[object.type]?.color||'#ffffff';
      const glyph=object.glyph||state.assets[object.type]?.glyph||'';

      ctx.save();
      ctx.textAlign='center';
      ctx.textBaseline='middle';

      if(object.type==='wall'){
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(135,144,170,.75)';
        ctx.strokeStyle='#c2c9df';
        ctx.lineWidth=2;
        ctx.fillRect(object.wx-cellW*.33,object.wy-cellH*.32,cellW*.66,cellH*.64);
        ctx.strokeRect(object.wx-cellW*.33,object.wy-cellH*.32,cellW*.66,cellH*.64);
      }else if(object.type==='goal'){
        ctx.strokeStyle=color;
        ctx.lineWidth=4;
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(object.wx,object.wy,object.radius,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(object.wx,object.wy,object.radius-9,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
      }else if(object.type==='enemy'){
        ctx.fillStyle=color;
        ctx.strokeStyle='#ffd7e1';
        ctx.lineWidth=2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(object.wx,object.wy-object.radius);
        ctx.lineTo(object.wx+object.radius,object.wy+object.radius);
        ctx.lineTo(object.wx-object.radius,object.wy+object.radius);
        ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
      }else{
        ctx.fillStyle=object.type==='target'?'#241016':color;
        ctx.strokeStyle=color;
        ctx.lineWidth=object.type==='target'?5:2;
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(object.wx,object.wy,object.radius,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
      }

      ctx.fillStyle=object.type==='target'?color:'#06101b';
      ctx.font=`900 ${object.type==='target'?18:14}px system-ui`;
      ctx.fillText(glyph||object.type[0].toUpperCase(),object.wx,object.wy+1);

      if(object.type==='enemy'||object.type==='target'){
        ctx.fillStyle='#e9f2ff';
        ctx.font='800 10px system-ui';
        ctx.fillText(String(Math.round(object.runtimeHealth)),object.wx,object.wy+object.radius+11);
      }
      ctx.restore();
    },

    drawAim(){
      const tuning=this.tuning();
      let dx=this.player.x-this.drag.x,dy=this.player.y-this.drag.y;
      const length=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
      const cap=Math.min(length,tuning.maxPull);
      dx=dx/length*cap;dy=dy/length*cap;

      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle='#5be9ff';
      ctx.lineWidth=4;
      ctx.setLineDash([10,8]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(this.player.x,this.player.y);
      ctx.lineTo(this.drag.x,this.drag.y);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);

      ctx.strokeStyle='#68ffad';
      ctx.lineWidth=4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(this.player.x,this.player.y);
      let px=this.player.x,py=this.player.y;
      let vx=dx*(tuning.force/100)*.82;
      let vy=dy*(tuning.force/100)*.82;
      for(let i=0;i<15;i++){
        px+=vx;py+=vy;vx*=.986;vy*=.986;
        px=clamp(px,BOUNDS.left+this.player.r,BOUNDS.right-this.player.r);
        py=clamp(py,BOUNDS.top+this.player.r,BOUNDS.bottom-this.player.r);
        ctx.lineTo(px,py);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  };

  window.GFBodyBridge=bridge;

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',event=>bridge.begin(event));
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',event=>bridge.move(event));
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',event=>bridge.release(event));
  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>{bridge.drag=null;bridge.draw()});

  function openConnectedPlay(reason){
    bodyBridgeStatus.classList.add('connecting');
    bodyBridgeState.textContent='CONNECTING';
    bodyBridgeRoute.textContent='Reading current JM.ProjectBody…';

    document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(view=>view.classList.add('hidden'));
    play.classList.remove('hidden');
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav button').forEach(button=>{
      button.classList.toggle('active',button.dataset.view==='play');
    });
    playGate.classList.remove('hidden');
    playResult.classList.add('hidden');
    window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});

    setTimeout(()=>{
      bridge.mount(reason);
      toast.textContent=`Connected ${bridge.scene.objects.length} objects to Play Test`;
      toast.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('show'),900);
    },40);
  }

  // Phone-safe direct routes. These do not depend on the inherited global
  // pointer throttle and therefore remain usable inside Android content://.
  let lastDirect=0;
  function direct(handler){
    return event=>{
      const now=Date.now();
      if(now-lastDirect<180) return;
      lastDirect=now;
      handler(event);
    };
  }

  const sendHandler=direct(()=>openConnectedPlay('send-body-contact'));
  sendPlay.addEventListener('pointerup',sendHandler,{capture:true});
  sendPlay.addEventListener('touchend',sendHandler,{capture:true,passive:true});
  sendPlay.addEventListener('click',sendHandler,{capture:true});

  const quick= document.getElementById('quickPlay');
  if(quick){
    const quickHandler=direct(()=>openConnectedPlay('quick-forge-contact'));
    quick.addEventListener('pointerup',quickHandler,{capture:true});
    quick.addEventListener('touchend',quickHandler,{capture:true,passive:true});
    quick.addEventListener('click',quickHandler,{capture:true});
  }

  const playNav=document.querySelector('.nav button[data-view="play"]');
  if(playNav){
    const navHandler=direct(()=>openConnectedPlay('play-nav-contact'));
    playNav.addEventListener('pointerup',navHandler,{capture:true});
    playNav.addEventListener('touchend',navHandler,{capture:true,passive:true});
    playNav.addEventListener('click',navHandler,{capture:true});
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-action="startPlayTest"]').forEach(button=>{
    const startHandler=direct(()=>setTimeout(()=>bridge.start(),0));

[] {}\n}";
const REQUIRED_ORGANS=['TokenBody','GlyphBody','RouteFrame','StateField','ContactBand','FormulaGate','Output','PunctBody'];
function parsePrimeBody(raw){
  const lines=String(raw||'').split(/\r?\n/), organs={}, failures=[];

    const line=lines[i].trim(); if(!line||line==='}') continue;
    const m=line.match(/^([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*:\s*(.+)$/); if(!m){failures.push('UNREADABLE_LINE_'+(i+1));continue}

   st.kineticPairs.set(pair,now);

   const impact=Math.abs(approach),rules=JM_IR.rules;
   const modeBoost=st.fieldModeIndex===2?(rules.kinetic_field_contact_boost||1.14):1;

     actor.vx=rx/rl*desired;actor.vy=ry/rl*desired;
     actor.squash=.48;
   }
